name: Mudra Mules
description:
Some shoes whisper luxury. These mules make it unmistakable.

Crafted in a soft beige tone, this pointed-toe pair has an ornate gold embroidered vamp with delicate motifs in zardozi, beads and scalloped detailing.

The slip-on mule silhouette keeps things effortless, while the high heel adds an elegant lift. Fine gold edging and intricate hang embellishments give the pair a distinctly festive, jewellery-like finish.

Wear them with a brocade saree, lehenga or a sleek evening look when you want your footwear to bring its own touch of glamour.

The pair is photographed in 4" heel height.

name: Sophie Mules
description:
With a little sparkle, this blush-toned pointed-toe heel is covered in delicate sequins and beads, creating a soft shimmer that intensifies beautifully towards the toe.

The pointed silhouette is balanced by a slim ankle strap with a neat buckle, while the heel adds a graceful lift without overpowering the intricate upper. Hints of pink, wine and champagne detailing give it a dreamy, jewel finish.

Let the shimmer do the talking from the first step to the last be it with saree, gown or your indo-western attire.

The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Paridhi Sandals
description:
A touch of tradition, reimagined with a little golden drama.

This ivory-gold sandals with intricate floral embroidery, delicate metallic threadwork and subtle zardozi embroidery. The soft neutral base lets the ornate detailing take centre stage.

Its open-toe silhouette keeps the look effortless, while the block heel adds graceful height and a polished finish. Pair it with a silk saree, anarkali or embroidered lehenga for celebrations that call for something special.

From intimate festivities to grand wedding soirées, this pair brings an elegant sparkle to every step.

The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Nebula Mules
description:
A little shimmer, a lot of attitude.

Nebula is a bronze pointed-toe mule with fine gold thread lines running down the front and tiny sparkles scattered between them. A soft trim of ivory daisies frames the opening, and the slim flared heel gives a sleek, leg-lengthening line.

Slip them on with wide-leg trousers, a cocktail dress, a sharara set or a fusion lehenga when you want something polished but not fussy.

The pair is photographed in 4" heel.

name: Opera Mules
description:
Made for nights that run late.

Opera comes in a soft pewter metallic with a pointed toe and a slingback strap. White petal appliqués sit in a neat row across the front, finished with pearl-like beads and silver thread, and small studs dot the toe. The block heel keeps you comfortable for hours.

Wear them with a black cocktail dress, a satin co-ord, a pre-draped saree or a jacket lehenga.

The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Radiance Heels
description:
Three straps of flowers and a heel you can actually walk in.

Radiance is a gold slide sandal with three straps covered in blush and gold 3D flowers, each with a small crystal at the centre. The round block heel is wrapped in matching gold, and the open-toe slip-on shape makes them quick to wear.

Pair them with a floral midi dress, a pastel co-ord set, a kurta with flared pants or a light anarkali for daytime functions and parties.

The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Sand Mules
description:
Earthy tan with a scatter of gold.

Sand is cut in soft tan suede with a pointed toe and a stacked block heel. Gold 3D flowers and little leaf sprigs spread across the front, adding shine without taking over the warm colour.

Style them with olive or rust outfits, a linen co-ord, a mirror-work kurta set or a flowy maxi dress for evening plans and festive dinners.

The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Ray Mules
description:
Clean lines, one fun heel.

Ray is a pointed-toe mule split into copper and soft gold panels, with a smooth finish and no extra fuss. The real talking point is the round ball heel in matching copper, low enough for long days and unusual enough to get noticed.

Wear them to work with tailored trousers, with denim and a crisp shirt for brunch, or with a kurta set and palazzos for small festive get-togethers.

The pair is photographed in 2" heel.

name: Slate Mules
description:
Bold stripes, quiet confidence.

Slate brings wide bands of pearl ivory and pewter metallic across a pointed-toe mule. The sculpted heel curves in at the back for a modern shape that still feels steady underfoot.

Wear them with monochrome tailoring, a little black dress, straight jeans or a simple kurta with cigarette pants for an easy indo-western look.

The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Sparkle Sandals

The heel gets just as much attention as the straps.

Wear them with a sequin dress, a pastel saree, a cape set or an indo-western gown for cocktail nights and receptions.

The pair is photographed in 4" heel.

name: Sonnet Mules

The open-back silhouette keeps it effortlessly chic, while the block heel adds a polished lift without overwhelming the look. Its monochrome palette makes it wonderfully versatile, from evening separates to festive Indianwear.

This pair is photographed in 3 inch heels

The beige base makes for a great match with most bridal outfits. With customizable designs and colours for flowers, you can add the necessary highlight to match your bridal lehenga. A perfect designer wedding wedge for the ages we would say. With custom heel height, you can get just the right amount you need :)

The pair is photographed in 4" heel.

name: Gulshan Wedges - Golden
description:
A perfect versatile wedding shoe with a golden base and some colour highlights. Choose the colour for highlights based on your lehenga and you are good to go.

Our most versatile and popular pair so far - Gulshan. This wedge heel with a pearl and zardozi hand embroidery makes for a perfect occasion wear. Be it your bridal outfit or your sangeet this footwear will be a great match with your dress. The added cherry on the cake is the unique eye-strap pattern. We bet you didn\'t see if before. It is our statement design!

The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Amara Chappals
description:
Catch the glow, skip the chase. These kolhapuris bring golden hour to your wardrobe.

These caramel-toned heels bring just the right amount of festive shimmer with their hand-done golden detailing and tiny sequins that glint as you walk.
The soft suede finish and comfy fit make them perfect for everything from mehendi brunches to cocktail evenings.

Because who said statement pairs can’t feel like second skin?

The pair is photographed in 3" heel height.

name: Tanuja Mules
description:
A little shimmer, a little chic, and a whole lot of charm that’s this pair in a nutshell.

The mules feature a striped ivory base with golden thread detailing and a dainty band of handwork on top - think tiny beads and metallic pipes arranged like a festive border. 
The block heels keep things comfy yet classy, perfect for slipping on with your lighter ethnic fits or trousseau looks.

When golden hour meets golden threads, you get a pair worth stepping into every celebration with.

The pair is photographed in 3" heel height.

name: Shalimar Flats
description:
A little bling, a little tradition these nude crossover flats strike the perfect festive balance.

The pair features a satin-finish base with one strap dressed in golden threadwork, sequins, and pops of red detailing in delicate heart-like patterns. 
Light, easy, and fuss-free, it’s that pair you’ll slip into for pujas, family dinners, or just to add a festive spark to a simple outfit.

Simple, soft, and subtly striking these flats do festive the easy way.

name: Twinkle Mules
description:
If festive sparkle had a favourite pair, this would be it.

These ivory slip-ons bring together tiny golden ghungroo on the edge and small sequins flower scattered across the base instantly catch the light and puts you in the limelight.

A little shimmer, a little structure, and a whole lot of “where did you get those?” energy.

The pair is photographed in 1" heel height.

name: Saba Wedding Sneakers
description:
You can be \'non-bride\', do all the work, and still shine while running around in these simple and comfortable sneakers.

A shoe we made for the \'less-heavy\' wedding outfits worn by the \'more-important\' family and friends. They do all the running around and need a shoe that helps. The silver golden brocade has its innate charm that we just let be. The matte silver used in rest of the sneakers also makes it an easy pairing with the light festive and occasion wear outfits.  

The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Sona Wedding Sneakers
description:
Who said sneakers can’t dress up for the big day? This champagne-gold brocade sneaker wedge is proof that comfort and glam can walk hand in hand.

With its floral fabric texture, chunky wedge sole, and shiny laces, it’s made for brides who want their shoes to shine just as bright as their smile. Perfect for dancing, strutting, and making sure every step feels as good as it looks.

The pair is photographed in 4" heel height.

name: Aambi Wedges
description: A golden wedge with a super comfortable base and a marquee look. A pair of shoes that make you look great, with ease, on your wedding day and on any occasions. The versatile golden and white combination makes it a great bridal shoe for a beautiful bridal look. The wedding footwear is super comfortable for a long duration wear. We know how weddings require the bride and groom to stand for long hours. We understand your pain and hence we made an extra comfort sole. It's the perfect bridal wedges that you actually want. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Quinn Sandals
description: When shimmer meets sophistication, you get this. These black block heels mimics a chevron pattern crafted with silver and gold sequins bold enough to shine, yet sleek enough to pair with everything from saris to cocktail dresses. With a comfortable block heel and open-toe design, this pair brings the party wherever you go. Because some nights deserve shoes that sparkle as much as your mood. The pair is photographed in 2" heel height.

name: Noir Sandals
description: For nights that call for some bold sparkles. These black block heels are dressed in gunmetal beadwork that catches the light with every move because subtle is sometimes overrated. The ankle strap keeps things steady while the cushioned base ensures the dance floor doesn’t stand a chance. A little shimmer, a lot of sass - exactly how evening heels should be. The pair is photographed in 4" heel height.

name: Opal Flats
description: When in doubt, cross it out with these chic crossover flats that are made to shine. Designed on a beige-gold base, the pair features smooth straps paired with a statement cross strap detailed in white and gold threadwork. The cushioned footbed keeps every step soft, making them an easy pick for long festivities, dinners, or even a quick twirl on the dance floor. Simple, stylish, and just the right amount of festive sparkle your feet will thank you.

name: Dina Sandals
description: This lovely red sandal hand-embroidered on a velvet base oozes class and royalty. A mix of flowers and some jaal work is sure to make it a great match with a lot of dresses. A red slip-on pattern sandal for your wedding day is always a great pick. This one especially has some neat flowers and intricately embroidered jaal towards the front. The covered front with the high heels is a great combination for someone looking for a great stance and comfort alongside. Notice the slight flat front as well. Oh that is our Midas Touch! The pair is photographed in 4" heel.

name: Kanika Sandals
description: Don't just show up, be the showstopper at every wedding. An intricately designed pair of mules where the small bit of embroidery leaves a big mark. In each small detail, we put a lot of thought to bring the threads, the sequins, the colours and the zari together. A perfect match for any outfit that has some pink detailing. No point hiding when you already bought a bright pink ouftfit :P The pair is photographed in 2" heel height.

name: Suroor Golden Sandals
description: Just enough shine to shine through the night. A muted ivory-golden pair that has just enough sequin detailing to lift your ethnic look. Much like the kurtis and light lehengas, we keep the embroidery minimal and monotone golden. We play with linear patterns and circular shapes in this one. After you adorn these, aap ka suroor will be the talk of the night! This pair is photographed in 4" heels

name: Ebony Sandals
description: Be a showstopper with heels that have a mysterious charm. Keeping it simple and letting your glam do the talking. A stylish pair of heels for your evening get togethers with your bestie. Step in and stroll out. Subtle dark tone applique work along with a touch of muted zari. Basically, these can be your go-to black heels from tomorrow. This pair is photographed in 3" heels

name: Flora Silver Sneakers
description: When sneakers decide to dress up, this is the result. These slip-ons with dainty flower motifs, each highlighted with delicate beadwork for just the right shimmer. The clean lines and cushioned sole keep it sporty, while the floral details make it festive-ready. Basically, they’re the bridal bestie of your shoe rack comfortable, pretty, and always in style.

name: Trove Budget Sneakers
description: Why settle for plain when your shoes can bloom? These floral wedge sneakers bring a playful twist to traditional festive wear. Designed on a soft beige base, the pair is detailed with peach floral motifs with tiny pearls at the center. Golden laces tie it all together, while the wedge sole keeps you lifted and comfy through long hours of fun. Perfect for haldi, mehendi, or even adding a cheerful pop to your trousseau days. Because every step feels lighter when you’re walking through flowers. The pair is photographed in 2" heel height.

name: Rumi Sangeet Sneakers
description: When the spotlight finds you, these sneakers make sure you shine right back. The smooth grey base is highlighted with beadwork that adds sparkle without being over the top. The wedge sole keeps you lifted yet steady, while the lace-up style makes it feel as easy as slipping on your favorite sneakers. Ideal for cocktail nights, reception dance-offs, or anytime you feel like outshining disco balls. Because Cinderella may have lost her shoe, but you’re definitely keeping yours. The pair is photographed in 2" heel height

name: Tira Golden Mules
description: When tradition meets just the right dose of sass, you get these chic festive heels. Designed in a soft golden base, the pair is highlighted with striped shimmer work and a playful border of sequins in red and green for that perfect pop of colour. The mid-heel keeps it classy yet easy to carry, making this your go-to pair for parties, pujas, or that one cousin’s cocktail you’ve been waiting to outshine. Shine, stride, and steal the scene these heels are ready. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Zyra Festive Sandals
description: For the days you want sparkle without losing your stride, these block heels are your festive best friend. The nude base is lifted with zig-zag sequin patterns, playful hints of hot pink and green, and a touch of floral shimmer around the edges. With a secure ankle strap and sturdy block heel, this pair blends style and comfort so you can swirl, twirl, and celebrate without a pause. A little glam, a lot of ease just what every party outfit needs. The pair is photographed in 2" heel height.

name: Mayuri Wedding Sneakers
description: When extra is the mood, these sneakers bring the drama. Crafted in gold base, this pair is layered with floral handwork, shimmery bead details, and a wedge platform that’s decked out like a jewel box. The lace-up design keeps it secure, while the towering sole makes sure every step feels like a spotlight moment. Call them sneakers if you want, but they’re really a full-blown party trick for your feet. The pair is photographed in 3" heel height

name: Trinity Golden Kolhapuri
description: When your heels shine brighter than the disco ball, you know it’s a good night. These golden block heels come with kolhapuri straps embroidered in geometric patterns of sequins and beads, catching the light at every step. The thumb-grip design keeps them easy to wear, while the cushioned sole makes them dance-floor approved. A little glam, a little comfort basically your perfect plus one for any party. The pair is photographed in 3" heel height

name: Morni Red Wedges
description: When tradition meets height, you get these fiery red wedge heels that are nothing short of a celebration. Covered in vibrant threadwork of peacocks, floral vines, and metallic accents, every inch of these wedges tells a festive story. The strap design with the back elastic keeps your feet secure while the cushioned base makes sure you can dance your way through the wedding without a care. Think of them as your perfect partner for comfort, colour, and a whole lot of sparkle! The pair is photographed in 4" heel height.

name: Kanak Slip-On Sneakers
description: Florals, but make them walk with you. This pair comes in a soft beige base, brought to life with leafy green stems and blooming white flowers stitched with delicate beads. The design feels breezy, nature-inspired, and still dressy enough to slip into your festive looks. With its cushioned sole and easy slip-on style, it’s that pair you’ll want to wear from mehendi mornings to casual evenings. Because comfort should always have a little bloom to it.

name: Ode Party Sneakers
description: Not your average slip-ons these are slip-ons with a secret sparkle. Crafted in a soft beige base with a subtle zig-zag texture, this pair is sprinkled with floral handwork in golden sequins, leafy greens, and little pops of peach. The white platform sole gives it that easy sneaker vibe, so you can glide through any function in comfort without losing the festive touch. Think of them as the happy middle ground between party-ready and comfort-first.

name: Ragini Slip-On Sneakers
description: Sunshine, florals, and a whole lot of fun packed into one pair of sneakers. Built on a crisp white base, these slip-ons bloom with colorful flowers in teal, pink, and yellow, with tiny beads that sparkle just right. The cushioned flat sole makes sure you can dance, walk, or simply show them off without missing a beat. If your vibe is cheerful and effortless, these sneakers will fit right in.

name: Juhi Kolhapuri
description: This soft gold wedge slip-on brings the best of both worlds, lightweight feel with festive flair. The wide strap sits easy on the foot , is sprinkled with delicate sequins and gold threadwork in tiny floral patterns, while the cushioned insole and steady wedge let you glide through long functions or cocktail runs without a single “ouch”. Bonus? The thong-style front keeps things breezy. Because your feet deserve to have just as much fun. The pair is photographed in 2" heel

name: Ojaswi Kolhapuri
description: A heel that brings all the festive energy with zero effort. This red block heel stands out with gold rope straps topped with sunburst motifs and a patterned heel for extra charm. Easy to slip on yet full of character, it’s the kind of pair that makes every step feel like a statement. For the days when you want your shoes to do the talking. This pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Amyra Sneakers
description: Shine so bright, the disco ball might just get jealous. These silver wedge sneakers are a patchwork of sequins, beads, and textured panels that catch the light from every angle. The chunky platform adds all the height with none of the “help me balance” drama, while metallic laces tie it all together with a wink of glam. Because when your shoes sparkle this hard, the dance floor is basically yours. The pair is photographed in 4" heels.

name: Alcove Budget Sneakers
description: Drama in the front, party at the bottom and comfort all around. This sneaker shall leave a mark. The sneaker comes dressed in champagne tones, sprinkled with dainty beadwork and oversized floral motifs that look like they’ve been doodled in gold. The chunky wedge platform gives you sky-high height without the wobble. Basically, if comfort and glam had a secret wedding, this is what their baby would look like. The pair is photographed in 4" heel height.

name: Bagh Ivory Sneakers
description: Built for the dancing night, packaged as a sneaker. This pair is wrapped in ivory tones with floral patterns stitched in soft gold thread, with sequins for that blink-and-you’ll-miss-it shine. The textured platform gives you height without the drama. If your outfit says ‘bridal’, your shoes can say ‘party's just getting started’. The pair is photographed in 3" heel height.

name: Cleo Silver Sneakers
description: Who said silver can’t be soft and striking at the same time? This pair brings together a dreamy satin finish with dainty floral mirror work, pearl-like detailing, and a bold circular motif at the toe for that one-of-a-kind flair. The wedge platform keeps you tall and comfy, while shimmer laces 'tie' it all up with a little sparkle. It’s the kind of shoe that whispers romance but still knows how to turn heads. The pair is photographed in 3" heel height.

name: Reet Wedding Shoes
description: Because why settle for basic when you can rise and shine literally. These platform sneakers are dressed in golden zardozi with scalloped patterns and dainty florals that bring just the right amount of drama. The glittery, cushioned sole gives you that extra lift (and attention) without compromising on comfort. Wear them to dance, twirl, or just show up looking unapologetically extra. The pair is photographed in 4" heel

name: Assi Banaras Sandals
description: Why stop at jewellery when your shoes can sparkle too? This pair is proof that colour, craft, and comfort can all come together beautifully. Rich panels of maroon, mustard and blue brocade are lined up like festive ribbons, each touched with gold detailing that glimmers softly with every move. The ankle strap keeps things secure while the cushioned sole ensures you can glide through weddings, sangeets, and celebrations without a second thought. Because the right pair doesn’t just match your outfit it makes the whole look feel unforgettable. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Ahilya Banaras Mules
description: This isn’t just footwear, it’s a full-blown festive statement. With its pointed toe dressed in brocade florals, glimmering sequins, and striking red stone, this green-and-pink mule knows how to turn heads. The block heel mirrors the same bold detailing, making sure your style shines from every angle. When the occasion calls for drama, this pair delivers it effortlessly. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Rama Banaras Sandals
description: When your footwear looks like it’s been dipped in celebration, you know it’s a keeper. These block heels bring together deep red, navy, mustard, and green brocade, highlighted with golden thread and dainty beadwork. Comfortable yet striking, this pair is designed to dance through rituals, laughter, and after-parties alike. Because some shoes don’t just finish the outfit they headline it. The pair is photographed in 2" heel

name: Niranjani Banaras Sneakers
description: Sneakers, but make them shaadi-ready! This pair is not here to blend in it’s here to steal every single glance. Wrapped in rich brocade patches of mustard and green the design is studded with sequins and beadwork that sparkle like stage lights. Whether it’s a sangeet performance or just keeping your trousseau edgy, this pair promises to turn tradition into pure fun. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Riwan Banaras Sandals
description: A little gold, a little glam this pair knows how to shine without even trying. It’s festive, fun, and the perfect plus one for your celebrations. Crafted with a sculpted golden upper, the design sparkles with sequins, while hints of pink and green add a pop of colour. The block heel is wrapped in yellow brocade, balancing style with comfort so you can glide through rituals and dance floors alike. Because sometimes, your shoes deserve just as much attention as your jewellery. The pair is photographed in 2.5" heel

name: Lalita Banaras Kolhapuri
description: When your heels decide to party as hard as you do, magic happens. This pair pairs mustard and fuchsia brocade with bead detailing that catches the light just right. The block heel carries the same festive fabric, making sure every angle is Instagram-worthy. And thanks to the cushioned sole, you can go from Haldi to after-party without missing a beat. Because why let your outfit do all the talking when your shoes are clearly in the mood? The pair is photographed in 2" heel

name: Manikarnika Wedges
description: Because some shoes don’t just lift your height they lift your whole mood.. With bold navy zigzag patterns highlighted in sequins, and colourful brocade panels peeking through in pink, mustard, and mint, the design feels playful yet regal. Add in the cushioned base, and you’ve got a pair ready to carry you through mehendi laughs, haldi playfulness, sangeet twirls, and every festive moment in between. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Matsya Banaras Mules
description: Who says your feet can’t be the life of the party? These heels are proof that every step can be a celebration in itself. Crafted in rich brocade fabric, the pair brings together maroon, green, mustard, and gold in a vibrant burst of festive colour. Tiny sequin details add that perfect glimmer, while the scalloped edge frames the foot like a jewel. The cushioned base and mid-heel keep you twirling, walking, and dancing long after the last dhol beat. The pair is photographed in 2" heel

name: Mira Banaras Sneakers
description: Why pick between glam and comfort when you can have both wrapped up in one sneaker? This pair plays up a deep green base with gold latticework, while bold brocade patches in hot pink, mustard, and pastel shades bring the drama. Sequins line the edges for that blink-and-you’ll-stare sparkle, all while the cushioned build keeps your feet party-ready. Think of it as your festive shortcut style that stands out, comfort that stays. The pair is photographed in 2" heel

name: Saroj Banaras Wedges
description: These wedges are vibrant, bold, and crafted for the woman who loves her traditions with a twist. The cross overlap straps come alive in rich brocade, weaving together shades of red, mustard, and green. A brocade-wrapped wedge heel adds drama, while the cushioned sole promises comfort that lasts longer than your playlist. Because why just walk into a celebration when you can stride in style? The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Pragya Kolhapuri
description: Who said minimal can’t be festive? These Kolhapuri-inspired sandals bring together a sleek ivory base with golden accents and a brocade block heel that pops like a surprise. Designed to balance understated charm with just the right touch of celebration, they’re your perfect go-to for pairing with ethnic wear or even a fusion outfit. Comfort meets style, so you can glide through the festivities without a second thought. This pair is photographed in 2.5" heel

name: Verra Wedges
description: Who said sparkle can't be subtle? This nude-tone wedge brings in the bling with a twist think sequins in champagne, ivory, and bronze, stitched in zig-zag and linear patterns that run along the strap and base. The ankle strap gives you that added support while the open toe keeps things breezy. It's the kind of pair that effortlessly shifts from haldi glam to rooftop sundowners. Minimal effort, maximum shimmer exactly how you like it. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Oyster Pearl Heels
description: Proof that pearls aren't just for your neck they belong on your feet too. This soft beige wedge brings the drama with criss-cross straps covered in delicate white beads and pearls, all hand-done to mimic that fresh, frothy look. The base is no less fancy it's sprinkled all over with the same beaded magic, giving you texture, shine, and just enough height to strut like you mean it. Perfect for the bride who wants to feel fancy without sacrificing a second of comfort. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Shooting Star
description: Reminiscent of the glow of a starry night, these mules bring the perfect mix of sparkle and sophistication. Set against a deep blue base, blue-rainbow cut-dana work and shimmering blue sequins create a subtle yet striking sparkle–like stars twinkling in the night sky. Designed for both style and comfort, the mule has a flared heel for stability and secure back buckle for the perfect fit. Effortlessly chic, this pair will light up every step you take. The pair is photographed in 2.5" heel

name: Hydra Navy Sneakers
description: A perfect Indo-western sneakers is not a dream anymore. Whether its running on a beach or hanging out in a lounge, the sneakers will give you great company. The embellished sneakers in monochromatic tones are a great fit for a lounge wear, a sangeet dress, a quirky party wear or hanging out with friends. The sneakers are with 2 inch of heels and a super comfortable sole. A long DAY and NIGHT of partying is not going to be a pain anymore. A hangover - well we can't say about that :P

name: Falak Heels
description: A little lift, a little shimmer this one keeps things effortless without blending in. The soft ivory base meets muted gold threadwork in a geometric jaali inspired from Mughal Architecture that feels dressy without trying too hard. Balanced on a platform wedge and shaped for comfort, it's perfect for evenings that call for something easy, yet elevated. Graceful without the drama, just the way you like it. The pair is photographed in 4" heel

name: Irene Ballet Flats
description: Checks over basics, always! This Mary Jane comes dressed in rich navy and rust checks with just the right hint of nostalgia. The V-cut front keeps things sharp, while the matching plaid strap and gold buckle bring that vintage-school charm. Built on a soft base for comfort, with details that do all the talking. Goes with socks, without socks, and definitely with opinions.

name: Marie Ballet Shoes
description: Pattern play over plain any day. This Mary Jane is inspired from princess pattern cut dress. With a textured navy-grey fabric that feels straight out of an old-school photo album and perfect for your all day office wear. The soft strap with a tiny gold buckle ties it all together equal parts comfort and charm, with just enough structure to feel polished. Definitely works when you want to stand out.

name: Agnes Flats
description: Sharp like your Monday mood, soft like your Sunday plans. These navy Mary Janes bring a tailored touch with their textured fabric and crisp cream edging. The V-cut topline adds a playful twist, while the bold gold buckle on the strap brings just the right amount of polish. Smart, subtle, and made to move with you wherever you're headed.

name: Susan Black Mary Jane
description: Old soul, bold sole. This Mary Jane pairs timeless houndstooth with a soft black toe and a cheeky little scallop edge upfront. Finished off with a matte gold buckle, it’s structured enough to feel put-together but soft enough to wear on repeat. Think classic, with a dash of sass.

name: Molly Flats
description: Plaid got a glow-up and a little heart on top. This Mary Jane blends vintage checks with a tan suede scallop inspired from good old Brogues that adds just the right dose of charm. The strap comes in the same weave, finished with a gold buckle that keeps it all tidy and snug. Perfect for when you want to look sweet but still mean business.

name: Hudson Office Shoes
description: Chic on the streets, soft on your soles. Built on a classic Mary Jane base, this pair combines nubby textured fabric with a checkered weave that feels straight out of a warm hug. The gold-buckled strap isn’t just cute it’s keeping things secure while you go about your day like it’s nobody’s business. Soft, sweet, and made for slow days or fast coffee runs.

name: Edith Mary Janes
description: A classic Mary Jane walked into a style upgrade and never looked back. Creamy vertical stripes meet deep brown edges in this refreshed take on the timeless silhouette. The pointed V-cut adds a little edge, while the gold buckle strap keeps things snug and secure. Equal parts soft, structured, and seriously versatile. Old-school silhouette, brand-new attitude.

name: Enola Quilted Flats
description: Not your average Mary Jane this one’s got texture and attitude. The deep wine upper comes quilted in soft hexagon padding like a cozy jacket, but make it fashion. Cream piping and a matching strap with a matte gold buckle keep it fresh and structured. It's the kind of pair that looks sweet but walks like it knows where it’s going. For days when “cute” and “bossy” go hand in hand.

name: Zoe Flats
description: A little bit schoolgirl, a whole lot cool. Wrapped in maroon checks and cream accents, this pair feels like autumn in shoe form. The textured beige flap adds depth, while the soft strap and gold buckle seal the look with just the right amount of polish. Built for crisp strolls, coffee runs, and everything in between. Checks, contrast, and cosy-weather charm what’s not to love?

name: Anmol Loafers
description: A deserving pair of loafers for the man who is about to kill it on the sangeet stage! Classic Indo-Western black loafers with golden stone and zardozi hand work. While the design is what may appeal to you now, break a leg in these shoes and you will bless us for the comfort. An apt choice for hours of mad dancing at your sangeet. Go be the Groom you were meant to be.

name: Abeer Sneakers
description: For the groom who wants his sneakers to show off just a little. This tan suede sneaker brings easygoing style together with a bold embroidered panel in the centre, featuring geometric mirrors and golden zari work framed in a delicate thread detailing. A little shimmer and pattern here and suddenly your casual kicks aren't so casual anymore. Wear them when you're "just keeping it chill"... but know they'll probably steal the spotlight anyway.

name: Ace Loafers
description: Think your shoe game can't get better? These blue loafers are here to prove you wrong. The deep blue upper gives off that rich, luxe vibe, with a soft, velvet feel that’s as smooth as your moves. The toe is adorned with a snowflake-inspired embroidery, crafted with blue and white stones, and golden zari work to form the design. Perfect for the guy who wants to look sharp on the big day - without stressing over every little detail.

name: Adi Mojri
description: If you're going to fly the radar, at least make it gold-plated. Set against a brown suede, a gold-toned bird swoops across the front, crafted entirely with golden, silver, and antique gold zari threads. The metallic embroidery brings a subtle sheen without tipping into flashiness, letting the bird glide between classic and bold. A pair for the man who knows understated doesn't have to mean unnoticed.

name: Avi Slip-on Mojri
description: The pair will steal the spotlight effortlessly! These tan mojris feature a crest-inspired embroidery in rich gold, blending subtle texture with standout detail. The laurel design adds a quiet nod to tradition, while the cushioned, quilted insole keeps things comfortable from morning meetings to late-night plans. A polished finish for the man who appreciates the finer details.

name: Ayan Loafer
description: So, you think loafers are just for the office? Think again. These slip-ons are here to prove that style doesn't have to stiff, especially on your big day. The dark brown upper keeps things classic, while the contrasting off-white toe adds a sharp touch. Golden embroidery runs along the seam where the two tones meet, keeping things crisp. Whether you're walking down the aisle or hitting the after-party, these loafers have got you covered (or should we say, shall we say your feet?)

name: Eve Loafer
description: Let your loafers do the talking - no other accessories required. This beige loafer brings the party with its all-over floral embroidery in golden sequins, zari, dabka, and white beads for just a hint of contrast. Every stitch is a flex, making sure your feet stay firmly in the spotlight. Because a good pair of loafers is the real power move.

name: Gajj Sneakers
description: Proof that royalty doesn’t always need a throne sometimes, just really good shoes. This pair packs in the whole baraat vibe without breaking a sweat. The rich brown base gives full “I’ve got this” energy, while that gold thread party happening on top? That’s your sherwani’s new best friend. Think of it as a mashup of dhols, motifs, and a lot of patience from some very nimble fingers to stitch into patterns that know how to hold attention. It’s bold, it’s detailed, and it definitely didn’t come to blend in because every king deserves his own grand entry.

name: Gus Mojri
description: Proof that your shoes can handle the compliments for you. This black velvet mojri features gold zardozi embroidery with a crest design and detailing across the front and topline. The rich border adds texture without going over the top, while the cushioned insole keeps it comfortable for long hours. A sleek update to a classic silhouette. The kind of pair that leaves people looking twice.

name: Jay Ethnic Loafers
description: Who needs a royal seal when your shoes are already this majestic? Made in a soft beige fabric with a slight sheen, these slip-ons are all about serious wedding swagger. The front band is where things get lively - bold threadwork in gold and bronze, parading proud elephants, swirling leaves, and a dash of sparkle. It’s the kind of flair that says, “Sure, I’m here to get married - but I’m not leaving without turning heads.” If your outfit’s the crown, these are the jewels sitting right under it.

name: Kamal Ethnic Mojri
description: Big day on the calendar? These shoes are ready. Finished in dark brown rexine, these mojris are outlined with gold zardozi work, where leaf-shaped motifs form a striking frame around the topline. The center lotus motifs adds definition, making them suited for wedding celebrations and standout entrances alike because ordinary just won't cut it today.

name: Liv Sneakers
description: When your sneakers party harder than your attire. This one's got drama, shimmer, and enough personality to outshine most cocktail looks. The matte grey base sets the tone, but it's the beadwork that steals the spotlight miniature black dots peppered across the top, broken up by metallic waves made from silver thread. The pattern? Think cosmic meets cocktail hour. Plus, you've still got that comfy sneaker sole so you can moonwalk from sangeet to afterparty without thinking twice. Perfect for the man who wants comfort and sparkle, all in one step.

name: Maheer Sneakers
description: When your sneakers manage to walk the line between tradition and trend, you know you've found the right pair. These brown slip-ons bring a quiet kind of style that fits right in with every wedding moment - no costume change needed. Victorian-inspired patterns in rich gold thread give the upper its character, with just enough texture to catch the eye without shouting for attention. The side detailing adds a graceful touch of tradition, while the quilted, cushioned insole keeps you comfortable from the first ritual to the last dance. A refined finish for every carefully chosen step.

name: Max Sneakers
description: When your vibe is pure cocktail night energy, these sneakers get the memo. Designed for the groom or guest who likes a little drama in his step (and plans to own the dance floor), they strike the perfect balance between festive flair and effortless cool. These black slip-ons blend laid-back comfort with just enough sparkle to stand out. The front is covered in fine hand-done detailing using sequins and fine glass beads - just enough shimmer to catch the light without tipping into over-the-top. The rest of the upper stays sleek in a matte leather-look finish, while the sole adds that casual, sporty edge. If sangeet-night sneakers are a thing, this pair would be leading the guest list - and probably the dance-off too.

name: Meru Sneakers
description: From daylight drama to baraat beats, this pair is made for the man who moves through his day like a pro and lights up the night like a firecracker. Whether you’re running the show or dancing at one, your shoes should keep up and make a statement while they’re at it. These slip-ons are built for exactly that. With golden bees embroidered up front and honeycomb patterns winding along the sides, they blend playful charm with edgy design. The threadwork is bold, clean, and just dramatic enough to turn heads - because why should you blend in? Step into these and let your stride start the conversation.

name: Milind Mojri
description: When timeless tradition takes a stroll with laid-back swagger, you get a pair that speaks fluent wedding cool. Crafted in a warm tan hue with a soft, velvety finish, the real star here is the embroidery. Delicate zardozi embroidery wraps around the topline in an elegant leafy pattern. Each stitch is done with care, adding depth and texture without stealing the show. Ideal for mehndi, these shoes are made for those who like to keep it understated, polished, and effortlessly on point. Sometimes, quiet confidence makes the loudest impression.

name: Naman Slip-on Loafers
description: Your outfit sets the tone, but your shoes seal the story - and this pair knows how to make an entrance worth remembering. Designed for the modern groom who doesn’t miss a detail, these slip-ons bring in a sense of celebration without ever trying too hard. Draped in a soft beige fabric with a subtle sheen, they balance grace and character effortlessly. The front showcases a elaborate floral motif, embroidered in soft gold, ivory, and hints of pearls - like a mandala reimagined for the aisle. The detailing is delicate yet precise, adding just enough shine to draw the eye without stealing the spotlight. They’re the quiet showstoppers of the wedding look - the calm, collected counterpart to all the dhol and dancing that follows.

name: Rayan Loafers
description: When embroidery does the talking, you walk like royalty. These aren’t just slip-ons—they’re a soft blush canvas where every thread plays its part in a quiet love story. The moment you step in, it’s not the shimmer or shine that turns heads—it’s the artistry. A generous bloom of light gold and deep rustic thread winds its way across the front, stitched with the kind of patience only handwork demands. Like a little garden unfurling with every step, it’s delicate, rich, and anything but ordinary. Perfect for sangeet twirls or sundowner vows, this pair is for the bride who doesn’t need sparkle to stand out. When your style is stitched with intention, the embroidery is your spotlight.

name: Rio Sneakers
description: For the groom who wants his feet to shine brighter than stars. This pair is all about cool confidence think silver tones on a textured base with a pattern that’s basically a modern-day maze (minus the stress). The embroidery is done in neat hexagon shapes with just the right amount of glint through glass beads to make it wedding-ready, sangeet-worthy, and after-party-approved. The comfort sole gives a “subtle flex” with every step. Because if you’re going to be running around all day, you might as well do it in something that looks like low-key jewelry for your feet.

name: Safi Ivory Mojri
description: Luxury, stitched in every curve and contour. This pair doesn’t shout for attention—it wins it with quiet craftsmanship and thoughtful design. Made in textured ivory fabric, these mojris feature an ogee-shaped motif embroidered in muted gold thread, bordered by fine metallic florals that glint ever so gently. The embroidery is subtle yet striking, forming a pattern that feels regal without the fuss. Clean lines, precise work, and a silhouette that speaks the language of modern royalty. When every thread is placed with purpose, the look speaks for itself.

name: Samir Sneakers
description: This isn’t your everyday pair. It’s festive flair stitched into a laidback shape, designed for the guy who wants tradition with a side of cool. These off-white slip-on sneakers blend comfort with craftsmanship, featuring detailed embroidery in gold and rust tones across the front. The leafy floral design adds a bold, artistic edge, while the tan sides and cushioned sole keep it easy and wearable. A casual silhouette with an unexpected twist. Built for dancefloors, baraats, and afterparties—this is your go-to when the plan is celebration on repeat.

name: Sultan Sneakers
description: This isn’t your everyday pair. It’s festive flair stitched into a laidback shape, designed for the guy who wants tradition with a side of cool. These off-white slip-on sneakers blend comfort with craftsmanship, featuring detailed embroidery in gold and rust tones across the front. The leafy floral design adds a bold, artistic edge, while the tan sides and cushioned sole keep it easy and wearable. A casual silhouette with an unexpected twist. Built for dancefloors, baraats, and afterparties - this is your go-to when the plan is celebration on repeat.

name: Taj Mojri
description: When your shoes show up with their own credentials, you’re not just part of the celebration - you’re setting the standard. This pair lets the zardozi do the talking, with time-honoured detailing that’s anything but ordinary. A regal crown sits proudly at the centre, surrounded by a golden wreath that nods to heritage without losing its edge. All of it comes alive on a rich dark brown base that balances boldness with refinement. The sleek upper gives it a refined look, while the quilted insole ensures comfort that lasts well past the final round of celebrations. A pair made to stand out with all the right kind of quiet flair.

name: Tarang Loafers
description: We agree these shoes might just outshine your best man’s suit, and dance moves combined. This pair is all about subtle statement-making, with a design that’s polished, refined, and thoughtfully put together. Crafted in rich brown silk, these loafers feature neat, intersecting threadwork in ochre yellow and gold that adds just the right amount of structure without going over the top. The embroidery brings in a modern touch, keeping things crisp while still feeling rooted in occasion-wear charm. A soft, cushioned insole lines the inside, so you stay comfortable through every toast, photo op, and dance-floor moment. Made for the man who appreciates the little things—because that’s where the magic really is.

name: Tarun Mojri
description: Your shoes walk in like they’ve inherited a quiet throne—no fuss, just pure finesse. It’s made for the groom who understands that power lies in precision, and that every detail counts—right down to what’s on his feet. This ivory mojri is a masterclass in refined detail, featuring delicate tone-on-tone embroidery with beads, sequins, and zari forming a regal geometric and floral motif across the toe cap and edges. The soft silk base and cushioned insole keep things comfortable while letting the craftsmanship do the talking. Luxury doesn’t always come draped in drama—sometimes, it arrives in measured steps, stitched with care, and grounded in grace.

name: Veer Mojri
description: We designed this pair for the groom who knows how to balance statement and restraint, letting the fit do the flexing without trying too hard. This burgundy mojri pairs a crocodile-textured faux leather with a sleek silhouette, topped off with a gold embroidered leaf motif right at the front. The metallic threads add a glint of detail without competing with the rich texture, making it a quietly confident pick for grooms who like to keep it sharp without shouting, and their swagger fully intact. The kind of shoe that backs up your best look with quiet authority.

name: West Loafers
description: Who knew geometry class would come in handy on your wedding day? These deep navy loafers are embroidered with sharp, layered chevrons in shades of blue and white, outlined with subtle gold zari for a crisp, structured look. The pattern runs along the front and sides, adding a bold graphic touch without overwhelming the classic silhouette. Set on a textured fabric base, they balance sleek design with a bit of edge. Finish strong, from aisle to after-party.

name: Yug Loafers
description: Occasion wear? Sure. But make it unforgettable. This black loafer is embroidered with metallic thread forming sleek, branching patterns, dotted with blue beads for a modern edge. A cushioned, quilted insole ensures comfort from the ceremony to the last round of celebrations. Made for the groom who's dressing for the biggest spotlight of all.

name: Dwaar Ivory Wedges
description: For days when you want a little shine without going over the top, this pair does the trick. With soft Ivory tones, delicate beadwork, and a hint of shimmer from sequins, these wedges strike a fine balance between festive and effortless. The cushioned platform and ankle strap add comfort and support, making them a great pick for long hours and light moments. Quietly dressy, comfortably stylish just how we like it. The pair is photographed in 4" heel

name: Goonj Regal Sneakers
description: When the bride wants power, comfort, and a little drama - Goonj delivers. This sneaker wedge skips the usual and goes straight for iconic. Wrapped in soft poly silk, it’s detailed with scalloped side panels, shimmering florals on the base, and proud elephant motifs at the toe, crafted to stand out at every step. And those gold laces? Just the final flourish. Whether it’s for the bridal entry or the sangeet spotlight, Goonj is made to lead the way. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Mitti Sandals
description: Boho, but make it grounded. This pair blends earthy browns, olive greens, and creamy tones with playful textures think chunky yarn, scalloped threadwork, and a little sequin shimmer for good measure. The white cushioned base keeps things fresh and comfy, while the fringed top adds a carefree edge. For the days you're feeling artsy, outdoorsy, or just done with boring flats. Photographed in 1 inch heel

name: Raet Sandals
description: Chunky yarn, chilled-out charm. This easy-going pair brings together warm tan tones and chunky braided threads in off-white and olive, giving off serious handmade energy. The square toe, comfy heel, and padded footbed make it perfect for slow brunches, craft fairs, or days when your to-do list includes absolutely nothing. For when your feet just want to feel cute and comfy. Photographed in 2 inch heels

name: Vayu Mules
description: When colour is not your way to stand out, but design is. This pair plays with sharp angles, textured yarn, and tiny beaded outlines to create a geometric pattern that’s anything but basic. The black base keeps it grounded, while the mid-block heel adds just the right amount of lift for dinners, gallery hops, or low-key celebrations. Wear it when you're feeling sharp, but not trying too hard. Photographed in 2 inch heels

name: Nisha Sandals
description: The most colourful black sandals ever! Crafted with colourful yarn threads and tiny bead accents, these pair of sandals add an artsy flair to your everyday lineup. Set on a soft black base with a comfy heel, it's built for casual outings whether it's errands, brunch, or just a walk with no destination. Slip them on when you want to keep it chill, but still look put together. Photographed in 2 inch heels

name: Jade Silver Wedges
description: This wedge is all shimmer on the outside and snug on the inside. With delicate aqua 3D petals, silver threadwork, and a clean scalloped strap, this pair brings just the right touch of pretty. The wedge heel features a textured silver base, so you're lifted and styled, without losing your grip. Ideal for festive nights, fancy brunches, or just making your trousseau a little extra. This pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Nehal Kolhapuri
description: The classic kolhapuri pattern with stark colours to shine through in ethnic wear. Well old is gold! So we adopted the age-old chappal pattern and added gold accents and upcycled brocade. These chappals are a classy affair. You wouldn't need a lot of effort to pull this off ;) This pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Aries Beige Sneakers
description: Sneakers are no longer just for the sidelines, they’ve claimed their spot on the wedding dance floor. This beige pair is a charming blend of comfort and craft. With delicate floral handwork in soft white and muted gold, each stitch adds a touch of quiet glamour. The body is built for all-day ease, that lets you twirl, hop, or chill through every ceremony. And the gold-dipped laces? A subtle nod to celebration without trying too hard. Designed for brides who like to keep it stylish without giving up comfort. The sneaker white sole is considered to be flats

name: Fiza Silver Wedges
description: Just the right hint of shimmer, without trying too hard. These silver wedges are dusted white beads and glass beads that catch the light without stealing the show. The sleek silver base adds a satiny finish, making them feel as easy as they look. For the days you want a gentle lift and a low-key glow. The pair is photographed in 4" heel

name: Aurelia Wedges
description: Not your average mirror work this pair makes it fashion. These low wedges come with cross straps that are lined with tiny mirror and gold beads, stitched in neat, diagonal rows that catch the light every time you move. The base is wrapped in a jute-style textured fabric, keeping things grounded and easy to pair with just about anything. Lightweight, comfy, and a little glam basically your new festive go-to. Because sparkle without effort? Always a yes. The pair is photographed in 2" heel

name: Oyster Heels
description: Forget glass slippers - these are the real fairytale. A soft light blue fabric is dotted with tiny white pearls across the toe strap, heel, and ankle strap. The pearls add a subtle, delicate texture to the design. A sturdy block heel keeps you steady, while a matching baby blue buckle at the ankle lets you adjust the fit. Made for moments that deserve a little magic. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Urvi Chappals
description: Kolhapuris have a timeless charm, unlike no other. These block heels blend tradition with delicate beauty. Set on an ivory base, gold and antique zardozi embroidery forms delicate leaves, while organza flowers bloom on the design, adding an ethereal charm. The balanced silhouette and sturdy block heel ensure comfort without sacrificing style. A perfect mix of heritage and elegance, they will be by your side for every special moment of your life. The pair is photographed in 2" heel

name: Peonies Silver Wedges
description: She’s not just a wedge, she’s the silver lining to your shaadi wardrobe. Wrapped in a soft fabric base, this pair sparkles with three straps covered in silver sequins read: no stress of slipping. The wedge heel is finished with delicate floral zardozi work that adds a playful pop without stealing the show. Comfort meets shine, with just the right touch of drama. Perfect for twirling, walking, or just looking fabulous while standing still. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Anya Wedges
description: Strap in, we’re taking tradition for a spin literally. This gold wedge sandal comes with a snug ankle strap and a broad front band embroidered with soft pastel florals and leaf motifs. The muted gold and silver zardozi work with sequins, pearls, and ivory threadwork that catches the light just enough. The base? Lightweight and textured for easy all-day wear, whether you're running trousseau errands or dancing through sangeet night. When comfort, sparkle, and secure footing come together—you know it’s a keeper. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Ena Wedges
description: When golden hour shows up in shoe form, this is what it looks like. This wedge flaunts a champagne-toned base with a woven texture that feels straight out of a summer dream. Up top, a bold strap is decked out with mirror work, tiny pearls, and beads stitched in curvy, playful patterns like a party for your feet, RSVP already confirmed. Bonus: the slip-on style makes it easy to glide into the spotlight. For haldi, mehendi or any day that needs a little extra sparkle this one’s got you covered. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Peonies Golden Sandals
description: Who knew neutrals could carry so much charm? This pair is all about quiet shine and easy grace. The soft golden base is dotted with floral threadwork and leafy details in zardozi that feel light, not loud. With a gentle heel and an easy slip-on shape, it’s made for long hours and longer compliments. A lovely pick for festive evenings, family gatherings, or when you just want a touch of something special. The pair is photographed in 1.5" heel

name: Urja Wedges
description: Turns out, being the center of attention is easier when your shoes are this pretty. The peeptoe design features a slim strap, with delicate floral patterns in white, accented by golden dabka that shapes the leaves and flowers. The front of the wedge showcases these same floral motifs, while the sides are adorned with geometric lines, sequins, and poth that add texture and depth. At the back, a large flower blooms, all set against an ivory base with tone-on-tone detailing for sophisticated finish. Careful. These wedges might upstage your outfit. The pair is photographed in 4" heel

name: Geet Kolhapuri
description: Comfort never looked this festive - or this finely detailed. These beige wedges with pearl and gold detailing are a quiet riot of craft. From tiny florals to layered geometric work, every inch of the heel is finished with delicate handwork that plays beautifully with light. The scalloped strap adds to that classic kolhapuri feel. The cushioned platform is edged with scattered motifs, giving you height without the hurt. Aap convince hogaye ya main aur likhu? The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Illusion Wedges
description: When your heels say disco and your soul says delicate, these wedges are your peace treaty. Perched on a light grey base, the platform is decked in geometric pattern where each section is outlined in gleaming bead lines that catch every twirl. Three sleek front straps arch across your foot, beaded in alternating matte and glossy finishes, bringing both rhythm and subtle sparkle to your stride. He loves me, He loves me not, He loves... Step out of the confusion with this Illusion. The pair is photographed in 4" heel

name: Melody Heels
description: Melody in your step, shimmer on your toes. These wedges are dressed to dazzle, with zardozi florals blooming across a soft silver base and sequin-detailed straps that catch every glint of light. The wedge heel flaunts chevron textures all around, giving drama from every angle—backstage to baraat. And yes, they’re comfy enough for an encore. Wear these heels all day long without lingering pain. For the bride who wants sparkle without the sore soles—these bring both. The pair is photographed in 4" heel

name: Esme Wedges
description: Your shoes are doing all the charming—no royal backup needed. These wedges shine with floral applique that glimmers on a dreamy grey base. The peep-toe brings just the right dash of drama, and the silver ankle strap keeps things stylish and secure. The wedge is so comfy, you'll forget you're wearing heels--until someone asks where you got them mid-sangeet or coctail evening. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Squirrel Quirky Mules
description: Charged with being toe-tally adorable with the cutest thing on your feet! This mule shows off a wide-eyed squirrel mid-scamper, tail fluffed up like it owns the place (which, let’s be honest, it does). The textured fabric base with thread work in muted colors gives it that earthy, forest-floor feel, while the comfy open-back design means you can slip in and dart out just like your furry little sidekick. Basically, it’s like having a tiny forest friend tagging along. The pair is photographed in 0.5" heel

name: Coco Mules
description: Tropical toes, coming through! The sandy beige fabric gives beachy vibes, while the leafy green palms are done up in tiny beads that catch the light (and compliments). They're light, chill, and basically scream “I’ve mentally checked out and gone island mode.” Slip into these and let your feet take a mini holiday even if you’re just headed to the wedding next door. The pair is photographed in 1" heel

name: Giraffe Kolhapuri
description: Why blend in when you can strut in giraffe mode? This Kolhapuri brings safari sass straight to your feet. With a giraffe face leading the way complete with those curious eyes and signature spots it's equal parts quirky and cool. The neutral base keeps things grounded, while the detailed stitching gives this tall friend some serious character. With just 0.5 inches of heel it is perfect for days when your outfit needs a little wild energy. The pair is photographed in 0.5" heel

name: Zebra Chappals
description: Stripes on your feet? Now that’s a power move. This kolhapuri with minimal heel brings in a zebra who clearly knows it's the main character. Black-and-white never looked this bold, with carefully stitched stripes, alert little ears, and that “I woke up fabulous” energy. The base is simple and comfy so the zebra gets all the spotlight (as it should). Slip in the Kolhapuris, strut out and let your feet do the wild talking. The pair is photographed in 0.5" heel

name: Haathi Chappals
description: Warning: This pair may cause random “aww”s and elephant-level attention. Front and centre, you've got a majestic elephant head stitched in shades of grey with tusks, ears, and eyes that could grab every eyeball in the room. The base is a smooth cream with a snug toe loop, and the strap’s got leafy little details peeking out to add a playful jungle vibe. Basically, it's the kind of sandal that makes you feel like the queen of the wild. The pair is photographed in 0.5" heel

name: Simba Kolhapuri
description: King of the jungle? More like king of your outfit. This Kolhapuri comes with a lion who knows it’s not just walking it’s making an entrance. With a golden mane, a calm-but-deadly stare, and stitching that roars with personality, this one’s got serious main character energy. The base keeps things fuss-free so the lion gets full attention. Slip these on and unleash your inner queen no growl required. The pair is photographed in 0.5" heel

name: Diva Indo-western Heels
description: Your feet deserve a little shimmer every now and then. These sandals bring just the right shine with zigzag sequins in gold, bronze, and silver—playful without being loud. The comfy block heel and neutral base make them an easy pick for everything from pre-wedding events to festive dinners. A little sparkle, a lot of comfort— your always go to option for indo-western or light occasion wear dresses. The pair is photographed in 2" heel

name: Buttercup Sandals
description: Spread some sparkle in every corner of the room with mirror work heels. Do justice to your pedicure! This pair of ethnic heels brings in a full party of golden beads, shiny mirrors, and floral drama—all stitched onto a ivory base that’s as soft on the eyes as it is on your feet. And let’s not forget that block heel: sturdy enough to survive the dance floor, shiny enough to make a statement. Perfect for the bride (or bestie) who refuses to pick between glam and comfort. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Adah Wedges
description: Florals for weddings? Yes, please. These wedges are a total scene-stealers. Soft pink with silver dabka vines curling their way across your feet—yep, these are anything but basic. Add to that sparkly pink sequin flowers that shimmer as you move, and tiny pearls sitting pretty at the heart of each bloom, and you've got vintage charm with a modern sass. If “wow” is on your wedding checklist, these are the shoes to tick it off with. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Buttercup Wedges
description: Careful, these wedges might just steal the spotlight from your lehenga. Crafted on a dark golden base, these beauties are adorned with meticulous hand embroidery featuring antique gold Zari-thread florals, glimmering mirror work, and delicate bead accents. The straps add style and support, while the lightweight wedge keeps you steady from the mandap to the dance floor. Put them on, and consider every step a photo-op. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Glory Sandals
description: When bling suits you glory will naturally be yours! A unique color palette only accentuated by the smart gradation in tones. A silver to begin with and a shine to last. In a stylish peep toe pattern, the slip-on heels are apt for your attendance at a wedding celebration or a festivity. Why be ordinary when you can stand out? The pair is photographed in 2" heel

name: Gaatha Bridal Sneakers
description: Who says brides can't run the world and to the mandap? This sneaker wedge brings unapologetic flair to bridal dressing. Loaded with geometric patterns made with hand-embroidered beadwork, pearls, sequins, and metallic threads, it's equal parts bold and beautiful. The lace-up front nods to street style, while the wedge sole gives you that bridal boost without slowing down. Made for dancing, running the show, or making that grand bridal entry--because your shoes should work as hard as you do. The pair is photographed in 4" heel

name: Florence Mules
description: Waves and pearls come together in this wedding heels, creating a design that feels soft yet striking. The pin-tucked fabric on the upper adds dimension, giving it a layered look. Pearls of different sizes line the edge. Finished with a double ankle strap for a balanced shape, this pair brings a unique blend of structure and flow. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Frost Mules
description: Some shoes make a statement–these whisper luxury in every step. Draped in delicately pleated fabric that catches the light just right, this heel is sprinkled with dainty pearls that seem to have settled like morning dew. The single strap keeps things sleek, while the heel adds just the right lift. A design that feels effortless yet unforgettable, made for moments that deserve nothing less. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Angela Bridal Heels
description: Not all fairy tales require glass slippers–some come with a little more sparkle. These heels are designed with an airy upper embroidered with delicate silver florals, creating a dreamy, almost weightless effect. Pear-cut and round stones shimmer with every step, bringing a radiant glow. The ankle strap and closed back provide a structured fit, making this pair perfect for moments that feel straight out of a storybook. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Camille Heels
description: Some heels make an entrance without making a sound. This design weaves together refinement and brilliance, with cross straps embellished with pear-cut stones that bloom into a flower at the centre, kissed by a single pearl. A fine border of tiny pearls traces the edges, adding a lustrous finish. Poised on a perfectly balanced heel, this pair is crafted for those who appreciate beauty in the finer things. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Clara Sandals
description: Style doesn’t have to be loud to leave an impression. A smooth white upper creates a refined foundation, while a delicate strap is dressed with soft gray organza flowers, each holding a radiant pearl. Set on a modest heel, this pair is the definition of understated beauty. The pair is photographed in 1.5" heel

name: Adriana Heels
description: Subtle yet impossible to ignore. This heel is designed with double straps, each lined with crystal flowers formed by precisely placed stones. The unique hexagonal heel adds a modern edge, balancing softness and structure. A perfect blend of refinement and bold design, made for those who appreciate quiet luxury with a twist. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Bianca Heels
description: If diamonds are a girl’s best friend, these heels are a close second. The double straps are lined with perfectly arranged rings of glistening stones and pearls, creating a design that refuses to go unnoticed. A flared heel adds a distinctive edge, while the square toe brings a modern balance. The kind of heels that don’t just complete the look–they make it. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Peonies Sandals
description: Soft, delicate and timeless–this is a celebration of subtle beauty. Set on a muted pink satin base, this flared block heel is adorned with silver embroidery, bringing peony flowers and leaves to life with a gentle shimmer. Graceful yet understated, this pair is for those who appreciate refined details. Whether for a wedding, a special occasion or for simply embracing charm, Peonies adds the perfect finishing touch. The pair is photographed in 2.5" heel

name: Naina Wedges
description: Classic red heels never go out of style. For an Indian wedding outing in any part of the world, a classic traditional heel is imperative. These wedding heels combine pearl and zardozi hand embroidery on a red base with white and golden contrast hand embellishments. The wedges ensure comfort throughout the course of the wedding with enough cushioned insoles. The embroidery is immaculate and they sit just right on your feet completing the overall look of your outfit. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Fiesta Wedges
description: Did someone say baila? With Fiesta, you’ll be twirling through the night effortlessly. Embroidered with gold sequins and beads, this pair glows against a plush black velvet base, creating the richest, deepest black. Perfect for fiestas, evening cocktails or sangeet, these heels will let you dance the night away–so effortlessly, that you won’t even feel it in the morning. The pair is photographed in 4" heel

name: Cinderella Sandals
description: Who needs a glass slipper when you can have Cinderella in mint green? These elegant closed-toe heels shimmer with a mix of sequins and glass beads, catching the light with every step. At the back, a soft mint green bow adds a touch of whimsy, perfectly complementing the dreamy design. Graceful yet playful, this pair is made for those who believe in a little sparkle and their own happily ever after. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Sahiba Wedges
description: Your wedding heels will outshine your bouquet! These golden wedges are here to steal the spotlight with a burst of red flowers - comfortable and delightful. The golden sequins and beads with the muted colour tones make it a super subtle pair for brides who don't like gaudy heels. For brides who want some floral flair without going full garden party, these wedges are a playful mix of elegance and boldness. The pair is photographed in 4" heel

name: Gulbarg Wedges
description: A hand-embroidered garden of flowers to welcome you into the new phase of life. Set against a striking red base, this bridal heel unfolds through thread and zari work, weaving together delicate floral motifs and graceful arches. With its harmonious blend of textures, shine and colours, these comfortable wedding wedges are perfect for celebrations that call for beauty with a hint of nostalgia. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Falguni Kolhapuris
description: Zardozi isn’t just embroidery; it’s a love language we speak fluently. Set on a luxurious maroon velvet base, these bridal flats feature an intricately embroidered peacock, brought to life in silver and gold zardozi. Pearls and dabka detailing add depth and texture, making every element stand out with understated elegance. Created for those who cherish tradition with a modern twist, this Indian footwear is ideal for festive gatherings, weddings or any occasion that deserves a touch of elegance. The pair is photographed in 0.5" heel

name: Cygnus White Wedges
description: Inspired by the grace and beauty of swans, these stunning wedges feature two swans facing each other, their necks intertwining to form a heart – an eternal symbol of love. Gold and silver-toned zari work covers these bridal heels, while soft thread work brings the swans to life. A touch of sequins on the swans adds just the right amount of shine. Elegant yet meaningful, this pair is a celebration of love, ready to carry you into the next chapter of life with grace. The optional elastic strap on these gorgeous wedding shoes add a touch of functionality for more confidence. The pair is photographed in 4" heel

name: Begum Heels
description: Mubarak Ho! You are becoming a BEGUM soon. Embrace timeless style with this stunning block heel. Featuring the regal blue of Lapis Lazuli and the classic ogee motif, it beautifully combines heritage and elegance. The tapered heel adds stability and sophistication – perfect for any occasion. The splash of colours on a dark green base has its own unique charm for a mehendi outing. We wouldn't say no even if you chose the heels for your wedding day. The pair is photographed in 2.5" heel

name: Kainat Wedges
description: We know you are your favorite - and actually ours too! Discover grace and comfort in these wedding heels. The slip on strap pattern and the comfortable cushioning provide physical comfort as your mother provides the emotional one. The intricate leafy designs and geometric patterns in the vibrant orange, reds, and muted gold, showcase our aesthetic, blending seamlessly with the Arabian influences. The antique golden sequin and zari work blended with the white beads make for a masterpiece. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Gul Bridal Sneakers
description: Brides-to-be, redefine tradition with our trendy bridal sneakers! A gorgeous combination of zardozi embroidery and sleek hexagonal shapes, often seen in Middle Eastern architecture. This union of tradition and geometry has us smitten – hope it charms you too! We blend green, mustard, maroon and pink to create a multicolour hue that sits well with any dark themed outfit. The white sole of the sneakers is considered to be flats

name: Firdaus Sneakers
description: Making bridal shoes worth stealing, one sneaker at a time! Make your mark with these sneaker wedges, mixing the latest trends with a traditional touch. The colours and motifs remind one of the views of Arabia. The metallic gold throughout seamlessly guides the eye, creating a smooth transition from one colour to the other. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Mehfil Bridal Flats
description: Designed for the bride who is grounded, but always glowing. Drawing from the enchanting mysticism of the Middle East, the flats have a dusky charm with dark colours. The touch of antique gold adds a venerable charm to the flats. The peeptoe front allows for some room to breathe and the comfortably cushioned soles do not leave an impression after those day long celebrations. The pair is photographed in 1" heel

name: Zoya Sneakers
description: These sneakers might just be your sole-mate :) Set against a plush peach base, the delicate gold embellishments add a regal effect to the sneakers. Pair these with your lehenga, saree, or fusion wear to create a statement with these sneakers. The white sole in the sneakers is considered to be flats

name: Ahana Flats
description: For the tall brides who want elegance and comfort. These unique bridal flats have a refined beauty, designed for those who prefer a subtle height. The ornate arches display eloquence in every detail. With rich colour tones, they beautifully complement your mehendi, making them the perfect bridal accessory. The little golden bead detailing almost remind you of ghungroos. The pair is photographed in 0.5" heel

name: Maryam Mules
description: When your lehenga isn’t the only thing turning heads. A multicolour slip-on mule is a great choice for the wedding celebrations. A simple geometric pattern with a pointed end and block heels for balance. The golden edges highlight the beautiful colours embroidered within the pattern. The blend of style and colours in these pair of sandals is one to admire. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Samira Wedges
description: Wedges so bewitching you would want to get them framed! The rusty tones bring the multicolour wedges to life. The golden 'jaal' throughout the wedge with neat zari work are our mark of finesse - almost reminding us of the peering eyes through a mask. The arches have a beautiful blend of Indian and Middle Eastern aesthetics allowing us to leave our mark on this collection. Each stitch hand done, this piece is a testament to the skill of the craftsmen refined over centuries. The pair is photographed in 4" heel

name: Afreen Sneakers
description: When you want to stamp your authority with some wedding sneakers, consider these! Inspired by the timeless spirit of souks, these sneaker wedges exude style and tradition. Done in rustic middle eastern hues, each colour is stitched into timeless piece with skilled craftsmen from India. Adorned with intricate zardosi embroidery, they echo the warmth of the exotic spices and desert sands. The hand embroidery on the hand made heels remind us of the way it's truly done for royalty. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Mrig Kolhapuris
description: Opting for flats doesn't need to hold you back from getting a royal pair. We place the beauty of the jungle to your feet. A brilliant display of finesse in Zardozi with threads and metal work. The deer is done in a mesh pattern with intricate layering. Each peach knot is individually hand done and carefully placed to adorn the unique pattern of these Kolhapuris. Call us to add a thumb grip if you need. The pair is photographed in 0.5" heel

name: Leela Wedges
description: The beauty of the peacock and the relationship of Krishna and Gopis embodied in one footwear. No better motif to carry the Indian bridal feeling better than a peacock. That, on a vermillion red base sets the tone for your new phase of life. Splendid use of zardosi handwork throughout the footwear to showcase what Indian craftsmanship is capable of. A fitting pair of heels for a couture lehenga and a bride with a royal taste. The pair is photographed in 5" heel

name: Keya Wedges
description: A splendid bridal outfit, deserves an equally good pair of heels. Resplendent use of zari on these bridal heels along with bright threadwork for highlights. The strap style on these wedges is stylish by itself, being wider at the edges for better grip. The small floral motifs with yellow, red and green highlights on a golden base makes it a super versatile pair of heels for all traditional wedding outfits, be it sarees or lehengas. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Mahi Sneakers
description: Trendy brides raise your hands! You are soon to be a sneaker bride. Indian craftsmanship restricted to great lehengas earlier, is now on shoes. Our artist rendered zardosi handwork, thread work and beads to create a traditional Indian footwear that is an appropriate match for an Indian outfit. And what better color than dark red, to represent the Indian bride. The white sole in the sneaker is considered to be flats
