name: Moonflower Sangeet Shoes
description: Floral embellishments have a 'natural' charm to them. On sneakers, they result in a perfect sangeet shoe. A tone on tone beaded sneaker with large floral motifs all along the shoe. A blend on grey beads, transparent glass beads and some stones for the shine. The lace up sneakers are super comfortable for a dance routine and have a natural ~1.25 inch height. We make our own sneakers hence you get the matching silver laces with a fine silver edging as well. The white sole in the sneaker is considered to be flats

name: Prisha Sneakers
description: The bride is the showstopper, adding one more reason to why that may be - A trendy bridal sneaker. In a classic combination of sequins and zardosi hand stitched on a maroon base. A comfortable shoe to compensate for your rather heavy wedding outfit. Not a bad match either with a traditional nauvari or kanjivaram saree. The white sole in the sneaker is considered to be flats

name: Moonflower Heels Sneakers
description: Floral + Silver + Sneakers + Heels - the perfect wedding sneakers doesn't exi..... We bring our finesse of embroidery in beaded floral motifs and some stones for shine. You get all the bling you need without losing any of the subtlety, the same way that you get all the heel height you need without losing any of the comfort. Indian sneaker wedges are all the rage in town as must a bride be at her wedding. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Mohini Sneakers
description: We know you need a comfortable pair of shoes for all the Garba dance. What better than traditional design sneakers? Incorporating the vibrant colors that mark Navratri celebrations for all Indians, we create this multicolor marvel. Interspersed mirrors across the sneakers complement the shine of your outfit. You will be inclined to Go for Garba! The white sole in the sneaker is considered to be flats

name: Kinjal Multicolor Sandals
description: Each mirror hand stitched, each colour carefully chosen, each girl worth it! A pair of festive block heels that will complement your joyful personality. Great for stance, great for dance. It will be a great match for your multicolour mirror work outfit that you chose for the Gujarati Garba with your friends. Beat them at the Garba look one shoe at a time! The pair is photographed in 2" heel

name: Hiral Festive Mules
description: We each have our fashion vices - For some its going bold with colours once in a while. A bright pink, some orange and yellow and a whole lot of mirror shine on these festive mules. You bet festivals will come in early with these mules on. A lovely balance of not just colours, but also mirror shapes - just the way we balance design and comfort. The pair is photographed in 2" heel

name: Raas Sneaker Wedges
description: When everyone's busy making a statement with outfits, you make one with shoes! A statement sneaker wedges with an unmissable shine and colour palette. You will be the talk of the entire girl gang once you adorn these sneakers. Spread some joy and a little bit of envy with a striking design that will set the stage alight. Make your mark with your moves and your mirror work embroidered shoes. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Bhumi Kutchi Flats
description: You bet we heard the tall Indian ladies when they said 'I need designer flats!' We 'paint' Gujarat on these flats with our immaculate hand done mirror work in a multicolour look. The flats have a cushioned insole and an anti-skid outer sole for you to move around tension free. The back support has a little elastic in it that latches onto your ankle to keep your feet in place. The pair is photographed in 0.5" heel

name: Dhara Peep Toe Sandals
description: We jazz up the traditional Indian red with some mirror work. These sandals done in a peep toe style and threadwork embroidery give a very folk Indian feel. Borrowed from the sensibility of the Kutch region of Gujarat this bold use of colours and mirrors make it a darling pair of sandals. The pair is photographed in 2" heel

name: Kanak Sandals
description: Never before were simple linear design and geometric shapes so attractive. The use of colours, blend of shapes, the shine of mirrors and a circular heel together make these a perfect pair of festive sandals. Each faux mirror is kept in place with stitches all around it. The circular heel pattern ensures greater comfort by distributing your weight over a larger surface area as you stand. The pair is photographed in 2" heel

name: Rewa Kolhapuri
description: A traditional design called for a traditional shoe pattern. Bringing the OG mirror work from Gujarat onto the OG footwear pattern - the Kolhapuris. We added some heels and then some embroidery on the heels to add some zing to the design. The bling - well that's already there with all the hand done mirror work. Get your preferred heel height and you are all set. The pair is photographed in 2" heel

name: Pinal Pastel Flats
description: Heels or no heels, a statement can still be made! These flats have a spirited use of bold and pastel colours - dark pink, baby pink, yellow and blue. All with some mirror work thrown in. Don't tell us it isn't great for a multicolour lehenga. Shine as you must. Dance as you must. The pair is photographed in 0.5" heel

name: Saras Wedges
description: The most comfortable heels combined with the most comfortable strap and with the most recognisable Indian design - the Kutchi mirror work. A neat double strap pattern with equallty neat embroidery that sets just as well on the heels as it does on the straps. A work of art we think with colours so well balanced as for you to want to buy an outfit that matches rather than the other way around. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Jill Mesh Sandals
description: Something to show off in these mesh embroidered heels. A lovely blend of materials to bring together a bunch of flowers on a mesh - beads, pearls, tissue flowers and stones. The mesh design makes it furthermore intriguing and something worth admiring. The detachable straps are another charm of these sandals. The high heels provide you a great stance and some height. Be the bride, stand tall above all ;) The pair is photographed in 4" heel

name: Hannah Mules
description: You thought we were not serious when we said we can bring your dreams to reality? Well, this can only be a shoe of dreams. This design barely needs any explanation. A shoe so drool-worthy that you won't be able to stop gushing over it. The flowers are done in a multi-layer ribbon embroidery technique only reserved for the most immaculate designs. The beauty is in the subtlety of this design. The flared heels add their little touch to the design as well. We also throw in an adjustable ankle strap for better grip as you walk down the aisle. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Jhalak Pink Sneakers
description: Some bold shine and some bold colours to create a sassy wedding sneaker. You call us if you don't get compliments for this one. The vibrant pink fabric with an even more vibrant embroidery, that is placed aesthetically. A lovely piece for an Indian wedding carnival. Could be great pair of shoes for those destination weddings by the beach too. Get your preferred heel height based on your lehenga and make your JHALAK asharfi for your man. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Anna Bead Work Shoes
description: We are in love with flowers - we are also human after all! A neatly embroidered bridal footwear design where the flower is the showstopper. We put shimmery glass beads on the straps and then put a large 3D multi-layered floral motif right at the center. No missing this beauty. We provide detachable dual layer straps on this design that gives you some flexibility on how to wear these sandals to your wedding. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Beth Pearl Sandals
description: It is your big day, no reason to be shy! A bold pearl design with a lovely flower for feminine subtlety. While we love the flower more, surely you will be split between which element of these heels you like better. Did we miss mentioning the flared heels? That's a contender too. A designer wedding heels that you can surely show off in - while still being comfortable. Each pearl is individually handstitched and a double folding detachable strap for some much needed flexibility. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Winter Mesh Sandals
description: Be your something blue at your wedding. A neatly done blue patchwork on mesh to create a stunning mule for a wonderful bride such as yourself. We accentuate the flower with a hint of white and with small stones for pollen. An easy slip-on pattern with an adjustable backstrap. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: August Butterfly Heels
description: Wear nature's marker for the beautiful, to your wedding. The beautifully done butterfly on these pencil heels are enough to turn a few heads. The subtlety yet elegance of these bridal sandals in white is supreme. The butterfly will sit pretty on your feet and be your constant companion through the wedding. It is a slightly flexible motif and hence won't bite you - just like a butterfly, only adding more beauty to the already beautiful. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Spice Sandals
description: A mesh embroidered heel so beautiful as to be hypnotizing. Done in a full mesh front with a spiral beaded design and a shiny stone for some highlight. The block heels a go-to choice in heels for most brides and we offer some options there. Photographed in 2 inches the heels can be made to your needs. Why settle for less when you are the bride? The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Rachel Wedding Heels
description: Worth keeping your eye on, as everyone else's will definitely be on this pair of heels. The stones shine through in the day, and the light blue sequins are subtle as ever. The entire motif is elegantly placed on the straps and the back of the sandals to make a darling pair of heels, just as gorgeous as the bride. The peep toe pattern allows for your feet to breathe and the insole focuses on comfort. A one time adjustable strap reduces the hassle for every other time. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Jocelyn Pearl Heels
description: All those who get your wedding invite will eventually end up envying this pair of heels. The pearl edging on these sandals leave an indelible mark on the bridal look. Did you notice the graded pearl sizes? The inner side of the pearl edging has a wavy finish to give a slightly feminine touch to an already bridal masterpiece. The double layer strap round up around your feet for the perfect fit and grip. The pointed heels do their magic to your stance as they add some height. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Jennifer Wedding Sandals
description: Be the talk of the town - at your wedding and thereafter. The design speaks for itself. The leaves and flowers stand out - quite literally from the sandals. The double layer strap gives you plenty of grip under the long gown. With the flared heel, you can be sure as you walk down the aisle. Ping us for a slightly wide fit. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Isabelle Sandals
description: The perfect heels with just a hint of color, for you and your heels both to stand out. We play with the petalled flowers with various materials, color and shine to bring together a wonderful pair of wedding heels. The hint of blue at the center makes the flower look wholesome and draws attention. The open toe design, adjustable strap and cushioned insole keep comfort in check. No more crying after long wedding hours due to the heels - in happiness you still may :) The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Bliss Slip-on Mules
description: Bringing the best of centuries old Indian craftsmanship so that you look your best on the big day. A flower is beautiful in all shapes, sizes and colors. We create our mini garden on these slip-on mules. The stylish flared heels and pointed toes make for a petite wedding look under your gown. The straps provide some flexibility on one end to allow you to slip into the mules easily and then hold your feet in place. We also did not let the insole be the boring plain one. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Autumn Satin Mules
description: Not only the groom can dress sharp, you can slay with your heels. A lovely pointed mules for your lacy wedding gowns. The small leafy details on a see through mesh give it a very classic feel. The double rounded straps give you enough grip in the heels. The net also allows your feet to breathe as you manage the long hours at the functions. The slightly cushioned insole also adds to your comfort. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Alice Floral Heels
description: A 3D flower as beautiful as the lovely bride walking down the aisle. Pardon us if the shoe takes away some attention away from the rest of the wedding outfit. A combination of an elegant net, a classic heel and some 3D floral magic make it a dream worthy pair. The pair is photographed in 3.5" heel

name: Kiara Bridal Flats
description: Good for you, good for your mother. Bridal flats in golden and nude tones with sequins and bead embellishments. The subtle shine comes from the golden glass beads in a checks pattern. It is in a comfortable slip on style for all the running around at Indian weddings and festivals. The right partner for the day and night, leaving no pain behind. The pair is photographed in 0.5" heel

name: Nazar Sneakers
description: SLAY in black! The party animal needs a shoe that complements. The best sneaker you can get for a cocktail evening this wedding season. High heels with premium hand embroidered bead work. A subtle shine against a pitch black base. The embroidered lines on these sneakers are done with extreme finesse with each bead individually hand stitched for the ultimate look. Dance like there's no tomorrow and the comfort will ensure you don't feel it tomorrow. The pair is photographed in 4" heel

name: Jewel Sandals
description: A 'no nonsense' golden festive sandal. A little curvy, these sandals make for a darling pair of heels. The circular heel and strap pattern with the intricate embellishment is an instant eye catcher. We use shiny golden and rainbow beads to make this one stand out so you can too ;) The pair is photographed in 2" heel

name: Melody Sneakers
description: Indians love silver in all forms. And what better than to have it in some beads and sequins. A shimmery and stylish pair of sneakers for the Indian weddings. The silver sequins embroidery punched with the glass beads in a geometric pattern make for a superb Indo-western footwear. The slightly silver matte heels make the embroidery and YOU stand out even more. The pair is photographed in 4" heel

name: Chhavi Wedges
description: The quintessential royal velvet and some golden zardosi that represents an Indian bride the best. Done in tones of maroon with shiny golden zardosi hand work, these heels are an easy choice for an Indian bride. The hint of green lifts the overall look of these wedges. The back of the heel and the straps incorporate an elaborate floral motif that is just as eye catching as it is difficult to craft. Cherish the beauty of nature as you look beautiful on the big day. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Mahika Wedges
description: For the simple love of Kolhapuris but with some heels for added height. A splendid use of muted pastel tones in the base as well as the flowers. The mint green used here sparingly is actually the star of the design. The curves ;) on these wedges are highlighted using a string of beads stitched neatly. It is a perfect versatile pair for the wedding functions and even before and after. Gift these to yourself or your mother and you can keep switching like you always do. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Vanya Peacock Sandals
description: The marvellous peacock stuns in every avatar, as does every bride on her big day. Embodying that spirit in these royal bridal heels. A time taking affair bring together beauty in the bridal sandals. The peacock is made in dual tone zardozi handwork and is the highlight of these heels. Made originally in 4inch heels, the front platform breaks the incline a little while giving you the needed height. The heels themselves have a small Jharokha, reminiscing the beauty left behind by the Indian rulers. The pair is photographed in 4" heel

name: Navi Wedges
description: An Indian bride adorned in shades of maroon, red, golden and greens is a sight to behold. We complement that look with our beautiful wedge heels. The sequins and thread work on the wedges is done beautifully on a rather thoughtful and unique shoe pattern. The straps on these wedges go all the way to back of feet to provide enough grip. The side has a cut to allow ventilation. The bunch of floral spreads on the heels are light on the eyes yet beautiful in their own way. The pair is photographed in 2" heel

name: Monroe Sandals
description: Zardozi in exotic colours - the offbeat RED. A warm dose of red for a traditional Indian bride. There is no other colour that mirrors the Indian bride better. In metallic zardozi handwork and shiny sequins for a classic red look. The straps are stylish, the sole comfortable and the grip perfect with the buckled ankle strap. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Madhuban Royal Sneakers
description: Awestruck - We are! And likely you too! The glory of the Indian peacock rendered on a royal sneaker. There is no better sneaker out there for a bride to be. The heels are all embroidered, all beautiful, but the real deal is the upper of the sneakers made with immense finesse and with supreme detail. The handwork on these sneakers stand out against any other. You will be showered with complements when you move around in these. We bet ya! The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Nila Sangeet Sneakers
description: Play the mysterious muse with the dark and dusky look. Tip toe perfectly in these sangeet and cocktail navy sneakers. A mix of rainbow beads and linear silhouette gives the pair a subtle shine and style. The tone on tone navy blue palette will help you rock your uber stylish cocktail gowns. A perfect pairing for your 3D origami style pleats form and structure outfits from Indian designers. The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Kashvi Bridal Flats
description: For a royal bride even her smallest steps during the wedding are precious. We created these mules for our tall brides and for our brides looking for flats to move around easily at the wedding venue and in between events. The design is floral and muted with our traditional Indian hand embroidery. If gorgeous low heel bridal footwear is a thing, this is it!

name: Crystal Wedges
description: A beautiful woman only deserves the best heels. A high heel design with large floral motifs in pastel tones. The applique work on this keeps the pair subtle and adds the originality. The stones and the sequins lend the intermittent shine. The white drop pearls and the golden beads make the design come together in all places. Even with all this the design has enough room to breathe and is soft on the eyes. The pair is photographed in 4" heel

name: Mayur Sandals
description: A pair of peacocks together can steal your gaze any time any day. With these lovely handcrafted peacocks on the sandals you will turn a few heads for sure. These sandals come with a superb strap style that holds your feet well while giving it a nice petite look. The small eye cut out in the strap add the extra edge to the sandal enhancing the design. With the peacocks embroidered on both the straps as well as the block heels, it makes for a darling pair for those ethnic outfits. With pastel shades for the base colour, you are not likely to go wrong on any occasion with these shoes on you. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Hope Pearl Sandals
description: Look no further for your dream occasion sandals - white on pastel. We brough all stylish elements of our design palette together in these sandals - the differential pearl embroidery, the curvy strap and the triangular high heels. You will have stance and class as you shine through in the appearance. A nice rose gold peachish tone makes the design soothing on the eyes, just as the image is. The pair is photographed in 3" heels.

name: Dawn Sneakers
description: Subtlety is the taste of the refined. A blend of Indian motifs with a nude colour theme. A warm ivory and white floral design for a wonderful pastel or muted gown, or a saree. That, combined with the comfort of our unique sneaker wedges, make it your best partner for a wedding outing. Be carefree in our sneakers and get the height you seek from sandals. The pair is photographed in 4" heels.

name: Amyra Sneaker Wedges
description: A mix of all great golden things making a great golden sneaker! Beads, zari, glass pipe, sequins, laces - ALL golden, ALL good. A unique mix of geometric portions with non-geometric filling in places. The blend of different materials across the sneaker, brings along different shine in places. No way someone can miss this when you adorn these golden sneakers with heels. Fine embroidery, finer style. The pair is photographed in 3" heels.

name: Dream Sneaker Wedges
description: 3D embroidery is a charm. We explored our DREAM design on off white hued sneakers A simplistic pair of sneakers with a hint of pink and golden. A neat combination of flowers in white, golden and pink in a 3D net embroidery. The few golden leaves add highlight to the shoes. The pair is photographed in 3" heels.

name: Aarzu Sneaker Wedges
description: The shoe that looks beautiful in any setting - your own marriage, your sister's marriage or a cousin. A charming sneaker wedge with resplendent use of drop shaped pearls. The off-white pearls on the sneaker are complemented with a touch of golden sequins, zari and some stones. The heels are a nice pale golden to keep the overall pair muted. It's a perfect pair of sneakers for your pastel outfits. The pair is photographed in 3" heels.

name: Jhilmil Bridal Footwear
description: Hi there! You found a wonderful wedding wedge for yourself. A bridal shoe that you can pick for your wedding and for functions later on. A great red pair with our authentic zardozi and threadwork. The steel grey metal leaves add a unique touch to this pair. The thick and thin double strap on this wedge, ensures great grip even in high heels upto 5 inches. The heels are kept light with zardozi and sequins floral spreads. Go for these for your a subtle wedding footwear that you can use later as well. The pair is photographed in 4" heels.

name: Celeste White Heels
description: A dreamy wedding shoe is everyone's desire - you can fulfill them quite easily now. We put it all in there - an exciting edge to the shoe, a mix of floral and geometric design, bead and thread work. The flared heel is ever so stylish giving you enough to charm while keeping you comfortable. We marry the color tone of the mule with a light cream insole for a neat finish. The suede lining keeps it gentle for your feet as you enjoy your wedding. A Christian bride should look no further. The pair is photographed in 3" heels.

name: Symphony Mules
description: A wedding shoe perfectly marrying comfort and design. Beaded embroidery in a dual ombre pattern - a mix of golden and white colour tones and a shifting density of embroidery. The white bead work is all hand done with utmost care. We chose to create this so that you have the wedding footwear you always desired and you can choose this to slay the walk! Even otherwise a versatile piece to add to your collection. The pair is photographed in 2" heels.

name: Aarshi Sneakers
description: Peach and sneaker whites and a play of lights. A trendy touch to your overall look with some gorgeous mirror work on sneakers. Amp up the pastel gowns with some pastel hued sneakers and catch some eyeballs as you dance. An unmissable sneaker with just two colours - peach and white with some silver shine.

name: Midnight Cocktail Wedges
description: Sharp dusky shoes to shine with a drink or two in hand. We combine the comfort of our wedges with sequins and beads embroidery that make the footwear a perfect pick for cocktail night. The unique strap pattern remains stylish while providing good grip. We also understand how a wide lower base can be useful as you dance, preventing you from stumbling. The anti-skid sole completes a perfect dancing shoe. The pair is photographed in 3" heels.

name: Rooh Wedges
description: This is to commemorate the union of 2 lovebirds - you and your better half. A wonderful design that we created with all our heart - just the way you will give your all to your soulmate. It is a testament to the fine Indian craftsmanship passed down generations over centuries. The zardozi and threadwork on these shoes are extensively hand-done over 50+hours. We take care of the comfort, you focus on the design. The pair is photographed in 5" heels.

name: Beeba Heel Sneakers
description: A perfect red shoe doesn't exi... A droolworthy shade of red in our sneakers. Sneaker wedges are for comfort during the dancing nights, and our embroidery lends a whole lot of charm to it. In this tone on tone embroidery on the sneakers and its heel we do our magic in hand embroidery. The work has a geometric undertone to it with just a hint of floral motifs. The pair is photographed in 3" heels.

name: Evelyn Wedges
description: Sharp as daylight - our shoes and your look once you adorn these. A quintessential sangeet footwear that is as comfortable as it is charming. A lovely hand embroidery design with a mix of sequins and glass beads. This wedge design is super versatile for any occasion. The dual straps on the wedge provide great grip while the sequins and beads shine through the evening. The slightly dark edging to the straps bring out the beauty of the design. The pair is photographed in 3" heels.

name: Garnet Wedges
description: A high heel wedges with shimmery hand embroidery that is a must for your cocktail collection. The ankle strap on these wedges keep your feet in place. The waterfall embroidery in a dual colour style adds the charm to the footwear that you will spread as you move through the night. Each bead is carefully hand stitched to and each pair exclusively handmade. You do not have to compromise on comfort as you spend the night dancing. The pair is photographed in 3" heels.

name: Heer Sneakers With Heels
description: There is none better than some white on ivory for subtlety. Walk down the aisle in a pristine white detailing sneaker with all hand embroidery. The white bead and thread work on the entire shoe in a geometric pattern make it an easy spot even from a distance. With the sneakers with heels all in trend, this is an easy pick for your wedding gown. Choose from varied heel height options and you are good to go. The pair is photographed in 3" heels.

name: Savera Wedding Wedges
description: A ivory wedding pair that is just as much an eye catcher as any gown would be. Move over the veil and find a new statement to your wedding outfit. The wedding gown needs a teammate that stands by it and makes you comfortable. Our wedges will do just that. A summer wedding shoe that just shines like the morning light - SAVERA. The pair is photographed in 3" heels.

name: Shireen Lite Wedges
description: Get your go-to pair of wedges for all wedding outings. A classic golden pair that can fulfill all your shoe needs. The tones of golden in combination with the slight touch of white beads make for a perfect ethnic wedges. The heels are textured and breezy for all outings. Pick from varying heel heights to suit your needs. The pair is photographed in 3" heels.

name: Shireen Sneaker Wedges
description: We just couldn't do without making our best design on sneakers, and in the most versatile colour - Golden. We did our Shireen embroidery on sneakers in a muted way. We kept the heels light with just textured golden fabric. We retained the three-flower pattern, but added a little tinge of green. The embroidery on these bridal sneakers is all hand done. The sneaker shoes come with embroidery throughout the upper, including on the counter. Feel confident of your look and comfort as you dance or run through the wedding festivities. The pair is photographed in 4" heels.

name: Aries Heel Sneakers
description: With all the ivory and light pastel lehengas and gowns you need one go-to pair of wedding shoes. A supreme combination of sequins, beads and slight zari. Done in muted golden tones, the highlight of these bridal sneakers are the golden leaves. They are petite and classy at the same time. The white flowers and beaded buds balance the look. We would say this sneakers is an obvious pick for being subtly trendy. With the colour customisation we offer, I am sure you will be all set! The pair is photographed in 3" heels.

name: Stella Wedges
description: We all fall for the grandeur of the forts in India - the beauty of the Jharokha, the arches the adorn the walls of the forts. This design is inspired from that beauty. The wedges come with a repeating pattern of various sized arches. We fill in our Jharokha with simple floral motifs to keep it minimal. The overall soft look of the embroidery makes for a neat ethnic wear that will surely add to your royalty. The neutral base for this bridal wedge also makes an easy match with most bridal lehengas - request your custom colour tones for flowers and you are sorted. Custom fitting? Oh that's on us! The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Kashish Wedges
description: A lovely dual shade heel - red and rani. Thread and zardozi work throughout the wedge heel for a comprehensive bridal look. Shine above all on your wedding day :) The straps are neatly embroidered in small floral pattern, with the thin straps of the bridal footwear giving room for the mehendi to show. The floral embroidery on the heel is the real deal here with a mix of threadwork and zardozi. We added a touch of colour highlights to complete the look. Look no further for your bridal shoes. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Jashn Sandals
description: We reminisce the old and traditional sometimes - more so during the wedding rituals when we bond for life in our own traditional ways. This pair of sandals is a testament to the most classic footwear pattern with the royal zardozi hand embroidery. A traditional red and gold combination is a no brainer as a trousseau footwear or a pair for the bride's mother for the ceremonies. A near perfect bridal sandal for a red and golden benarasi or kanjivaram saree. The pair is photographed in 2" heel.

name: Carina Pink Sneakers
description: If you wish to make a statement, then there is no better colour to go for - A STATEMENT IN PINK. We did these quirky sneakers for our bold and beautiful women. The dark pink base with lovely flower motifs in tissue embroidery are a charm. Each petal for the flower is individually embroidered and layered together to create the beautiful sneakers. The stone at the centre draws attention to the flower. The laces on this one are a blend of golden and pink tones for a lovely ethnic look, while we do also provide standard white laces in the box.

name: Pankh Wedges
description: May your heart be full with happiness and you dance like a peacock through your wedding celebrations. A mesmerising wedding footwear to live the journey with you. A peacock embodies the natural beauty and the joy of the monsoon. We have the peacock in all it's glory on the wedge heels. The embroidery is a lovely combination of white beads, threads and sequins. We adore this strap pattern just as much as all the brides who have preferred our footwear. The heels, as usual, are lightweight and comfortable for long wedding or family functions. The pair is photographed in 4" heel.

name: Cinnamon Sneakers
description: A sneaker wedge that is spicy and subtle. It carries a charm of its own. Done in hues of brownish golden with all gold embroidery, this shoe is as versatile as it gets. We retain the subtlety of our design by keeping the heels muted, without any embroidery. It is a perfect sneaker for the weddings you want to attend without being the showstopper, but still grabbing a few eyeballs. The pair is photographed in 4" heels.

name: Shireen Sneakers
description: For the brides that are hopping onto the sneaker trend for comfort and style but keeping it muted - we did these pastel bridal sneakers in pink tones. Lovely pastel base with the white eyelet facing and sole gives a classy sneaker look. The hand embroidery on the sneaker is a combination of beads, multicolour threads and some zari. The golden laces make it all fancy for occasions. Switch with the white laces that we provide complimentary to make a statement piece under your denims.

name: Gemini Off White Sneakers
description: You would want to go to a party because you want to flaunt these sneakers! Isn't a great shoe reason enough to shake a leg. With all the dancing around a wedding -be it a Christian wedding, a North Indian wedding or a South Indian wedding - we know some comfortable wedding shoes could help. But why compromise on design or style for it? A lovely nude shoes for those pastel and white outfits during a wedding. A must have sneaker for a beach or a destination wedding.

name: Olivia Flats
description: For all the running around during a wedding, a family function or a festival. Keep it low and comfortable in these versatile golden occasion wear flats. The cushioned insole and the low heel make for a comfortable day out. The strap will provide a great grip with a the broad edges, while the narrow centre makes it look petite. The zardozi and sequins embellishment makes it all festive-festive - all hand done. The pair is photographed in 0.5" heel.

name: Jhalak Bridal Sneakers
description: The OG mirror work embroidery from India coupled with the centuries old zardozi - one glance is not enough for our JHALAK sneakers. An OTT embroidery with a cool boho look on a black velvet base. The monochromatic tones of the sneakers are just gorgeous. The golden stands out against a dark background and the mirrors lend the shine. The shiny golden around the laces further accentuate the look of the sneakers. Team it with a dark silver or black outfit during your sangeet or cocktail and women shall die to catch one more glimpse of these. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Faith Bridal Sneakers
description: Shine like the moonlight and set the night ablaze in these silver bridal sneakers. Keeping the embroidery rather minimal, we let the colour and the shine do the talking. The leaves and flowers are intricately hand embroidered on these wedding sneakers and there's just a hint of peach in there. This colour of the sneakers is customisable to match your outfit while keeping the pair largely versatile for a cocktail, a sangeet or a carnival during Indian weddings. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Mia Sneaker Wedges
description: On your wedding day, you don't need to compromise for comfort any more. A sheer beauty combined with comfort in these bridal sneaker shoes. The sneaker wedges come with the traditional zardozi and pearl embroidery and a golden wedge heel. The red base for the bridal sneakers is the quintessential Indian bridal red. The heel is accentuated with a textured golden fabric to keep it subtle and royal. The pair is photographed in 2" heel.

name: Dream Shoes
description: 3D embroidery, bright colour palette and a lovely pink velvet base - need we say anything more about these shoes. Lovely embroidered flowers in multicolour, high wedge heels and the comfort and cushioning of sneakers combined into one wedding shoe. Wonderful pick for all those brides and bridesmaids looking for great design combined with supreme comfort. All your concerns for a long dancing night can now lay to rest. Pick these uber trendy wedding shoes now and make heads turn. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Stardust Sneaker Wedges
description: Straight out of a fairytale are these trendy sneaker shoes. The comfort of the sneakers combined with the comfort of our wedge heels. A rusty golden base with lovely sequins work on all sides. We have used stones, pipes and sequins in tones of gold and copper to create a wonderful look. With the soft lining on the inside, the sneaker will hug your feet as you dance on a sangeet night or party in a cocktail gathering. Statement shoes for sure! The pair is photographed in 3" heel

name: Paris Sneakers
description: Lovely pearl embroidery on the latest trending sneaker shoes. What more can you ask for? We picked a lovely satin finish rose gold base and embellished it with pearl and golden beads. The wedding shoes have a super comfortable wedge heel with embroidery throughout and a running border at the lower edge to accentuate the look of the sneakers. Wedding functions or otherwise, these are sure to keep you in the limelight. The pair is photographed in 4" heel.

name: Victoria Wedges
description: Add to the shine in your look as you walk the aisle for your man! A quintessential golden heels for before, during and after your wedding functions. We picked some unique golden sequins and created this golden beauty. This has a whole lot of shine to turn heads. The heels are done in a geometric pattern while the straps catch all the attention with the layered sequins work. We used 3 sequins and some beads to come up with this classic. Get it in your preferred heel height. The pair is photographed in 4" heel.

name: Tara Wedges
description: There is nothing like an overdose of sequins - ultra glamorous always. We bring the best of glamour on footwear for you. These wedges are marked with golden shiny sequins handembroidery interspersed with the occasional colourful flower. The flowers and leaves on this bridal footwear are embroidered in dual tone hues in a dark-light format. The heels are a great pick for attending all those wedding ceremonies - whether your won or of your BFF's or realtives'. A must have go-to pair for the Indian celebrations. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Elsa Sandals
description: Hello there bride-to-be and their lovely bridesmaids! Shine all you want in a lovely shimmery dress and matching footwear for the cocktail and sangeet nights. The lovely ombre hand embroidery in hues of silver and blue make for a lovely blingy sandal - a rather classy bling. The glass beads reflect light and project a dual colour palette. Get your custom colour tone to replace the blue and you are 'golden'. The pair is photographed in 2" heel.

name: Pharaoh Sneakers
description: Fancy some trendy sneakers for a cocktail or a sangeet night during your wedding? These sneakers are resplendent with zardozi and sequins in hues of golden and silver. A lovely geometric pattern goes throughout the shoes with an even shine. We provide an optional regular white sneaker lace along with the slightly blingy golden one. Shine on!

name: Eve Wedges
description: We love zardozi like no other footwear designer would. We brought together hues of gold, silver and white to create a marvellous treat to eyes. We used a light golden base, golden sequins, golden zari, golden and silver dabka and white beads for stealing every gaze in every step. Not just the embroidery, we have designed these golden heels keeping the bride's comfort at the forefront. Super cushioned soles, lightweight heels and soft lining throughout make it a dream to walk in these. The modernised kolhapuri look speaks to the new age brides. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Zohra Wedges
description: For those brides that want to keep it subtle - it has its own charm. We did this wonderful bridal footwear with touches of golden and white on an ivory coloured base. Additionally, we kept the hand embroidery on the heels on the lighter side too with a lovely border going around the heels. The strap pattern is our latest introduction where it provides great grip along with some style. The little dark brown highlight on the insole is what binds the design together and lifts it overall. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Sasha Wedges
description: Velvet is the bride's fabric we think. And some golden metallic embellishment is the right partner. Turns out this is the perfect footwear for a traditional red Indian outfit. We did a combination of the quintessential red velvet, some zari work combined with small whitish beads to create a lovely design. The heel of these wedges are done in a geometric pattern to keep it rather simple. This is a great potential match with all those zari work border sarees that women across Indian tend to adore. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Yuki Sneakers
description: Subtlety speaks volumes. With a cool blue and white combination of these sneakers, it is easy to make a mark but with class. The sneakers combine Indian embroidery techniques on a bluish grey fabric that has a shine of its own. It is embellished with silver zari work and small white beads that make them each look like snowflakes. The laces are a shiny silver, though we provide an optional white lace also.

name: Savanna Designer Flats
description: How can we forget the birds of the tropics? The lovely colours that we see in all the bird species in the tropics are a treat to the eyes. One such is the contrasting black and yellow hues of the Toucan. These super comfortable mules in suede are a darling for your casual footwear needs. The lovely tan shade of the upper with the intricately hand embroidered Toucan in beads that are super neatly embroidered in various directions. The details are just phenomenal on this one. The pair is photographed in 0.5" heel.

name: Pecky Toucan Mules
description: How can we forget the birds of the tropics? The lovely colours that we see in all the bird species in the tropics are a treat to the eyes. One such is the contrasting black and yellow hues of the Toucan. These super comfortable mules in suede are a darling for your casual footwear needs. The lovely tan shade of the upper with the intricately hand embroidered Toucan in beads that are super neatly embroidered in various directions. The details are just phenomenal on this one. The pair is photographed in 0.5" heel.

name: Melon Jeans Mules
description: Some love for our watery friend from the tropics - the Watermelon. The bold bright red colours emanate an infectious energy. The beaded watermelons give an instant tropical feel with it one of the most prominently available fruits in the region. The shades of green give an all natural feel and the dual tone denim makes an easy match with different colour denim outfits. Go for these perfect casual footwear for your weekend get togethers. The pair is photographed in 2" heel.

name: Paradise Denim Mules
description: In love with 3D embroidery this year - loving every bit of the multicolour flowers on these denim mules. A floral treat in multicolour - pink, blue, yellow, and green leaves. The light on the eyes, yet colourful look of these denim mules make for your perfect partner on a pair of jeans for a quick casual outing. The denim flats come with a 0.5" heel for a touch of style. The pair is photographed in 0.5" heel.

name: Cherry Sliders
description: On on off we find some love in the mountains. The people from the tropical regions do love their one off vacations to colder places in their country and outside. And then boy, do we indulge in cherries! The lovely versatile colour palette of this slider is worth every penny. The skin tone fabric, the touch of greens and the bright red highlights are a great combination. The dark suede highlight on the insole and the small 0.5" heel gives the casual slipons a super premium look. The pair is photographed in 0.5" heel.

name: Lily Stylish Sliders
description: The classic white and blue on denims, with some great floral embroidery. A wonderful treat to the eyes. The embroidery is super intricately done on this pair. The white lined petals leave room for the denim to show creating a mesmerising look. You get awed by the threadwork and the bead work on this one. The sole is soft as ever and a delight to walk on. The heels are just right at 2inches and flared for a sharp casual look. Go on grab 'em! The pair is photographed in 2" heel.

name: Flamingo Trendy Sandals
description: In the times of barbie, a little pink does no harm. Pick a comfortable denim casual footwear that is your barbie statement either on a pink, white or a blue bottom. While a casual slipon sandal, the work on this is anything but easy. The flamingo has those little detailings and the leaves are in different shades of green. All this on a denim fabric, took more than its fair share of time to handcraft for you. The piece is sure to grab eyeballs and a statement piece in the casual range. Add to this the slightly flared heels and you shall be the talk of the party and your footwear too :) The pair is photographed in 2" heel.

name: Lime Mules
description: Add a little zing to your life with some bright tropical colours. A refreshing walk won't be that tough anymore. Bright yellow lemons for the ultra tropical feels. Intricate yellow beads and transparent glass beads are nicely blended to give a real world feel for the lemons. The footwear is great for daily walks with a padded insole for comfort. The dual part upper highlights the footwear embroidery even more. The slight denim detailing on the sole also lifts the look of the mules. The pair is photographed in 1.5" heel.

name: Java Floral Mules
description: The omnipresent tropical flower - The hibiscus. We love the hues of these flowers - from red, to yellow to pink and the favourite red. We picked 2 prominent colours of the Hibiscus for this design - shades of red and yellow. The dual tone flowers are neatly done along with the long filaments for the pollen. The dark base for flowers on an otherwise light denim base makes the design stand out even more. Love this for a great casual walk. The pair is photographed in 2" heel.

name: Palm Blue Mules
description: A leaf goes through various stages in its tropical journey and we see leaves in different colours and sizes. These blue denim mules embody 3 such leaves in a well balanced design. These comfortable and washable mules come with embroidered leaves in white, green and brown. The overlapping leaf design gives in all the three colours evenly across the entire upper of the footwear. It is super pleasing to the eyes while giving a subtle beachy vibe. It is like a breath of fresh air amidst all the chaos of regular shoes you may carry. The pair is photographed in 2" heel.

name: Gardenia Jeans Sliders
description: The classic white and blue denim combination, reimagined with some hand embroidered texture on these sliders. The flowers on these sliders are one to die for. Great craftsmanship over several hours results in these wonderful footwear designs. The extra green element on it, adds the tropical touch for the white flowers characteristic of this region. We retain our supreme comfort elements with super soft lining and cushioned soles. The pair is photographed in 0.5" heel.

name: Flutter Denim Sandals
description: All the colourful flowers and fresh leaves are bound to draw in some butterflies. Oh what shall we not give to have the full year as Spring! Intricately made floral and leaf patterns with each individual knot hand embroidered in variety of colours. The dark and light denim pattern lends a very classy casual look perfect for a tropical outing. The sole is extra cushioned for comfort. The pair is photographed in 1.5" heel.

name: Clover Denim Sandals
description: We all love a touch of colours on our casual wear now and then. For this piece we picked colours from the nature of the tropics - the greens, the bright yellows and deep reds. The embroidery on the sandals incorporates a super skilled spring and knotting technique. We used a combination of 2 techniques to create the wonderful flowers on this one by hand. The 2 tone denim base offers a great visual appeal further bringing focus to the wonderful hand embroidery. Pick a washable casual pair like this one for your daily outings. The pair is photographed in 2" heel.

name: Isabelle Golden Wedges
description: We all crave a footwear such that is perfect for any wedding function - an Indo-western sangeet night or a short carnival at a destination wedding. And why compromise on comfort while you crave the look? There is no footwear that captures the Indian golden hues better than this pair. A lovely combination of similarly hued glass beads with a 3D element to top it up. The ankle strap and the platform heel ensure comfort as you walk or dance. The strap is a peep-toe and allows for a petite and feminine look. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Avni Wedges
description: A heartwarming piece with all the colours for a lovely bride who is going through a variety of emotions as she approaches her wedding. The real delight of these wedges lie in colourful front straps and the elaborate motif on the platform heel. We used various colours of threads, sequins and dori to create a marvellously coherent design. And no compromise on the functionality - the elastic back strap provides the extra grip you need under a heavy bridal lehenga. Go for it. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Vega Party Sneakers
description: A perfect party shoe doesn't exi..... We got you your best party shoes yet to show off your dance moves. A sneaker so good that you can't resist. The pair has an OTT party look for you to shine as your moves slay on the dance floor. Each bead is carefully hand stitched to hold them together with durability. The colour tones are super party like with a lot silver and golden. The sneakers by themselves come with ~1inch heels and extra cushioned sole for comfort as you dance. We did a little designer laces to go with the look as well. Go on set the trend with these party sneakers.

name: Carnival Sneakers
description: We were a little playful and designed a sneaker to go with that mood. Oh well, aren't we all the same during the wedding functions - especially Haldi and Mehendi! An adorable mix of colourful threads, faux mirror and sequins on a light golden poly silk fabric. The individual mirrors, sequins and threads are all hand embroidered. The overall colours of the wedding sneakers give it a very Indian feel and embody the joyous free spirit. The mirror work also resonates very well with the lovely mirror work attires from the Western Indian states of Rajasthan and Gujarat.

name: Cassie Wedding Sneakers
description: Haven't you thought sometimes - What if style and comfort could co-exist? Well that's what our wedding sneakers play at. The traditional zardozi embroidery throughout these bridal sneakers makes it a perfect pair for any lehenga. The embroidery is completely hand done to give this pair of sneakers an uber ethnic look. The shine and style of the work is impeccable and is complemented well with the comfort sole. The golden laces are optional and a spare white lace is also provided for easy breezy wear.

name: Pandora Sneakers
description: A splash of colours on a quintessential white sneaker base - the pink, the yellow the dark pink and minty green. Super cool designer sneakers for young girls to bode with your livewire personality. The OG comfy shoes for every occasion and casual outing alike. Each flower is done intricately with a contemporary tissue embroidery technique that takes ages to master. We particularly also love the pearl centre for the flowers and the silver linings. The laces are done in silver tones as well, though an optional white lace is provided with the sneakers as well.

name: Gemini Blingy Sneakers
description: A tone on tone sneaker so good, that you will want to a plan a party just to slip into these! A nice blend of silver-grey along with the sneaker white. The glass bead and sequins hand embroidery adds a super classy shine to these party shoes. We did silver laces on these as well. The ogee motif on these women's sneakers give it the slight feminine look, and add the traditional touch for the family outings or ethnic wears during sangeet functions. Go ahead and pick one for your shoe collection. The white sole is ~1inch from the ground

name: Lyra Sneakers
description: Live your perfect haldi function in our trendy colourful sneakers. A bright yellow base with multicolour flowers to take your haldi look to the next level. The sneakers come with comfortable insole for you to jump into an impromptu dance during all the celebrations. The pristine white laces and sole make the bridge between your traditional yellow and the casual sneaker pattern. Wear these wedding sneakers and cherish YOUR haldi forever.

name: Aries Bridal Sneakers
description: Choose something extraordinary - by design and by level of comfort. Take some comfortable steps while you walk into a new phase of life. The uber trendy sneakers are stitched to perfection. The designs are all hand done with intricacy and precision. The sole of the sneakers will keep your feet at rest during the long and tiring wedding ceremonies, while the embroidery will reflect your excitement. The peach hues of this piece with the golden and white highlights sit right for a tone on tone theme.

name: Leo Party Sneakers
description: In our quest for comfort we had to reach here - Sneakers! And Golden for versatility. A sneaker design fit for a party or an ethnic / festive outing. The golden white tones of embroidery are eye catching and pleasing at the same time. The shiny golden laces lend the necessary bling ;). Dance carefree in these pair of sneakers as you may almost forget you are wearing any at all! All beads on this piece are hand stitched for higher durability. And these sneakers are washable! What more do you need??

name: Ahva Wedges
description: Symbolic of the bond that binds two souls to make them one forever. A lovely pair of heels with impressive use of colours and thread work along with zardozi embroidery. The wedge heel has an intricately made golden motif at the back with a branch of flowers going all around the sides. The bright red base for the shoe helps make the other colours pop. Well, you deserve to be the showstopper on your wedding - without a doubt. The pair is photographed in 4" heel.

name: Aza Sandals
description: This is a combination of all the right things in one place - a pleasing rose gold colour, embellishments for enough bling and ankle straps for comfortable partying. The shoe design is great for sangeet, parties, kitty parties and more - as versatile as it gets. The shoe comes in a 2-part front which enhances the look on your feet and makes the symmetric embroidery stand out. The slightly shiny rose gold undertones complement the hand embroidery embellishments beautifully. Look no further for a eye catching piece ;) The pair is photographed in 2" heel.

name: Gulshan Nude Wedges
description: A nude wedding shoe in cream and golden tones for an easy match with your wedding attires and more. The comfortable platform heels are adorned with exquisite pearl and zardozi hand embroidery for a perfect occasion look. Be it your bridal outfit or your ethnic dresses from the trousseau later on - this one will match them all. We retained the unique eye-strap pattern. The slight white touch of the beads along with the golden work gives it a very premium feel. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Cira Wedges
description: A light shade of gold interspersed with some red. Just the way the sun shines every dawn. One of our lovely designs primarily built around tear drop pearls. The off white pearls lend a nice view on an otherwise light golden base, while the red threads are what draw attention. The thread work on this pair is also something we have come to love. Go for a traditional Indian hand work for your wedding day and you are sure to shine. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Saar Wedges
description: Some zardozi, some thread work and a whole lot of Indian motifs to bring in the right emotion for wedding days. We added a touch of green and orange threads in our embroidery to make the different elements stand out. The shoe comes in an open toe strap pattern that allows for good grip and some room for your toe rings. The basic heel height provides a little lift to the already tall brides but adds a great deal to the overall embellishment. The pair is photographed in 2" heel.

name: Nyra Bridal Sandals
description: A classic Aari Taari hand embroidery on a pair of flats for a breezy bridal affair. It is an easy match with a range of lehengas from the best bridal designers. Red and golden - the colours that define most North Indian brides. We love donning those shades during the weddings. Then why not have a ready pair to go with those ethnic dresses? Grab this pair to go with your Sabyasachi, Anamika Khanna, Anita Dongre or Tarun Tahiliani and other designer lehengas. The pair is photographed in 2" heel.

name: Zuri Platform Heels
description: Subtlety is classy! Go monchromatic in tones of golden for your wedding attire. The platform heels come with intricate beads and zari golden embroidery. The muted beige base colour makes the shiny golden work stand out just enough. The work on the heels are placed along the footbed, running like a border, making it easy on the eyes. It is a perfect embroidery style for brides looking for some neat embroidery without any OTT work. This one makes for a great pair even post wedding for most ethnic outfits. The pair is photographed in 4" heel. The model is wearing 3" heel.

name: Gulshan Velvet Sandals
description: Red + Golden = A perfect bridal wear. We created this red pair to edify your already wonderful bridal lehenga. All the right ingredients in one bridal shoe - a rich velvet base, antique beads, golden zari handwork and peach highlights to go with your dupatta. The dense hand embroidery throughout the sandals makes this pair of heels a darling. Get these dream wedding shoes now with your preferred colour knots and a super comfortable sole. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Aza Sandals
description: A little OTT once in a while is good. Couple that with a love for super versatile colours and embroidery and you have this darling pair of sandals we call AZA. The embroidery on these heels is a mix of glass beads, pearls, sequins, zardozi and more. The closed shoe pattern along with the elastic back support provides a solid grip. The golden tone sandals are great for women seeking perfect occasion wear heels. The sharp cut for the closed front will only add to your indo-western or light occasion wear dresses. The pair is photographed in 2" heel.

name: Cira Chappals
description: The classic chappal pattern with in modern colour tones and embroidery is the way we see it. Well old is gold! So we adopted the age-old chappal pattern and added our own bit to it with the pastel shade embroidery. Done in tones of muted off-white and purple, these chappals are a classy affair. The pearl work and the thread embroidery add a certain touch of class. You wouldn't need a lot of effort to pull this off ;) The pair is photographed in 2" heel

name: Isabelle Wedges
description: We all love to flaunt some silver attires during and around parties, wedding functions or festivities. Well, this pair of platform heels will make a perfect match for those. The design comes with small touches of elegance and our handcraft in places. The flowers have a 3D centre, bright blue tone inner rings and asymmetric shapes and sizes. This is surely one of those designs we keep looking back to draw inspiration in bringing subtlety to big and bold patterns through the right choice of colours and embroidery. The high wedge heels, a gripping ankle strap and singular curved front strap complete the sharp yet classy look of these footwear. The pair is photographed in 4" heel.

name: Tinsel Sandals
description: Purple party sandals in transparent heels - OH YEAH! The shine, the shimmer and the colour on these heels is just Waaaooow! The clear kitten heels of this party wear give a great stance and the laces hold your feet as you sway to the music. The perfect pair of sandals to dance the night away. Once a dream now a reality. Get extra soft comfort soles on these shoes on request. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Oyster Wedges
description: The world is an oyster and you are the pearl. Treat your feet with these luxury wedding shoes. The designer wedges have been handmade to ensure high comfort and handcrafted to give the touch of Indian authenticity. The pair is a perfect choice for any major occasion, be it those wedding outings for just another party. The pair is photographed in 4" heel.

name: Patti Sandals
description: An elegant combination of Maroon with Golden leaves to adorn your feet in the colours of an Indian bride. A luxury wedding shoe specially handcrafted to enhance your bridal look for the wedding. The sandal is made on a premium satin fabric that lends it a long-lasting shine. The zari work just adds to the overall look. It is a no-brainer with your wedding lehenga. Request a quick customisation for colour below and you are golden! Leave the rest to us. The pair is photographed in 2" heel.

name: Gulshan Bridal Sandals
description: When you want to make a statement, there is nothing like royal golden wedding block heels. A neat floral zardozi design inspired by Indian handicraft to help you put your best foot forward on your special occasion. The classic combination of golden with some pink highlights is sure to match tons of your dresses for every occasion. These bridal sandals will add a certain charm to your outfit. The pair is photographed in 2" heel.

name: Kajal Sandals
description: Just as that 'Kajal' lines the most beautiful feature of the bride's face, we come with this piece that is sure to add a similar touch to the attire! These versatile embroidery on a black velvet base will go perfectly with every outfit and on every occasion. Share your desired colour for the velvet and get a custom piece that matches from the lightest of kurtis to the heaviest of sarees. The pair is photographed in 2" heel.

name: Hazel Wedges
description: A go-to pair of wedges for any occasion. Suits perfectly for sangeet ceremony during weddings or for a late night party. The single rectangular strap with an elastic heel strap or a single cross strap in slip on style. The dual tone beadwork makes this bridal wedge a classic to wear in wedding days. These shoes can be teamed with western, Indo-western or Indian attires. With the black & grey the handmade wedge is sure to be your regular companion for any occasion. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Parizad Sandals
description: The new colour in town. A dark green under the lights shall make you exude class like none other. It is the best pair for on open lawn mehendi or haldi function. A green bridal sandal with antique golden hand embroidery design makes it a perfect mehendi shoe. Oh how you can show off those decorated feet in these single strap sandals! The back support on top of the block heels hug your feet as you move. Its super stylish with full aari handwork on the single strap. The pair is photographed in 2" heel.

name: Gulshan Chappals
description: An intricately embellished bridal chappal in red is what you need for your special days. A footwear design, so classy that guests won't be able to take their eyes off. These super comfortable and hand embroidery designer chappals will help you enjoy all your wedding events to the fullest. Just slip your feet in and enjoy your special moments without any discomfort. It is a unique setup of design and comfort in one pair of wedding shoes. You don't have to pick one over the other. We bet you will not miss the ease of your sneakers. The pair is photographed in 2" heel.

name: Nooree Wedges
description: An ethnic bridal shoe with a mark of its own. A motif, so drool-worthy as to set the night alight and steal your beau's heart in a beat! The wedding wedge is a great combination of premium design and great comfort. The shoe comes with a comfortable inner sole and a lightweight outer sole. Intricate zardozi and dabka hand-embroidery design in this red wedding footwear is the epitome of royalty. It also makes a great pair in a golden base. Reach out for a custom made pair. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Cira Peep Toe Sandals
description: One of those breathtaking bridal sandals! The high block heels and the neutral colors with peep toe design can accentuate any dress any day. This pair of nude wedding shoes make for a great head-turner. The pearls combined with the thread work using classic hand-embroidery techniques lend a royal touch to the sandals. You shall be a queen not just in the eyes of your king but in the eyes of all Baraatis at the wedding. Go for some customization for the colours to match your lehenga and nail the look! The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Nooree Designer Shoes
description: We all know how some of those wedding events last long. This is one handcrafted pair taking care of just that - in red and super comfortable! A perfect pair of flats for all girls who are looking for some comfortable bridal footwear with a great design. The thin front strap on the flats adds elegance, while the back support adds drama to the shoe. In the quintessential red, this pair of bridal flats is an easy decision to choose

name: Ira Sandals
description: For you might want to floor your man with your golden heart and some crazy moves! A white luxury wedding shoes with a touch of gold. It comes with kitten heels for an edgy bride. You can rock your sangeet night in these uber-trendy bridal sandals with the tie back for extra grip from the shoe. The thin front strap allows you to show off your nice Mehendi designs. The tone-on-tone hand embroidery designs make it a classy piece of nude wedding shoes. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Blush Sandals
description: No wedding is complete without a bride donning a quintessential pink shoe and this pair is that one perfect luxury wedding shoe. With lovely pink sequins and glass heels, this makes for a perfect bridal shoe for sangeet and all other wedding ceremonies. You can team them up with a designer gown or a bridal lehenga or even just with a pair of denim as they are a versatile pair of beautiful bridal heels. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Zia Sandals
description: A perfect pair of bridal high heels to stand out in your sangeet ceremony. One pretty bride - people are surely going to remember for a long time. For those brides who are looking for some extra bling in their sangeet outfit. The glass heels can be filled with stones, pearls, glass beads, and whatnot! Shine with every step in these super trendy, designer glass heels on your wedding days. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Shireen Flats
description: Well sometimes we like to keep it simple on our occasions. Just a little bit of golden base with some subtle hand embroidery designs of flowers to enhance the look. A golden pair of bridal flats are a great versatile pick for your wedding days. It is likely to find a great many matches with your bridal attires. You can slip in and out of these chappals easily, and go from a casual outing to a full blown dance in a jiffy. The cross strap pattern provides a great grip while allowing you to show off your mehendi. This is many shoes in one :)

name: Ira Nude Wedges
description: Nude wedding shoes that go with all your wedding attires. It has a mix of golden glass beads, white pearls, and sequins. The high heels and the light colours add to the overall look of the bride. These bridal wedges are super lightweight and are an angel for your feet. These will hug your feet and provide comfort for your wedding day. You will not have to think twice before picking these shoes for a long duration of wear. They won't hurt your ankles as you stand with extra comfortable soles. The pair is photographed in 4" heel.

name: Scarlet Bridal Sandals
description: A red bridal shoe that has a fair amount of bling and style. We understand how a bride wishes for a pair of red wedding heels within a budget. The glass beads and the red base add a royal look to the bride. With classic golden leaf designs, it is sure to match your wedding attire. Go for this pair to turn some heads while keeping it simple. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Shireen Flats
description: We are in love with this shoe embroidery and seems like the brides are too. A refreshing red colour bridal flats for the Shireen embroidery in velvet base. The embroidery in these platform bridal sandals stands out with the red and pink tones. The flower work is sure to make it a good match with any lehenga that has a touch of pearls. It has all the right elements going for it - the zardozi leaves, the multi-colour small flowers for highlights, double strap for grip, extra cushion insole for comfort, and white pearls for a touch of spark. Go for it! The pair is photographed in 1" heel.

name: Sion Wedges
description: An ornate bridal footwear in high heels, just the way a bride likes it. What more, it comes in a rich velvet base. The golden zardozi work shines through the wedge and will surely set you apart on your bug day. This design carries the right mix of golden flowers with colour highlights in leaves. The cross strap pattern of the wedge provides a great grip. The slip on pattern of the shoes also makes life easy on the wedding day. We give a comfort sole along with lightweight wedge heels to ease your steps. The pair is photographed in 4" heel.

name: Ira Sangeet Sandals
description: We understand the heart's desire for a matching pair of new shoes. This pair of sandals looks as great every time you wear them. And the golden tone of embroidery on a golden base makes it a subtle match for all your attires. So go on book this perfect pair of sandals for your wedding ceremonies. We bet you, these will come in handy for far more than you imagine during your shaadi. A golden shoe is anyways a dulhan's basic possession. Look no further as we created a darling of a sandal for you with extreme comfort and grip in mind. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Mia Wedges
description: We all have a few parties or get togethers to attend right after our weddings. One relative from his side, one relative from her side - so that you both settle in with each other's families. Use all your red attires and don't you worry we have the right newly wed shoe for you. Neatly embroidered in small beads and zari, this wedge is in the classic kolhapuri pattern. The pair fits perfectly for a Banarasi saree with subtle zari work. It is with a twist though. We did a fancy net strap to show off your feet and some lovely placement handembroidery to be opulent yet classy. There is no missing this pair and is just apt for your early days in a new family. Let us know if you need something else ;) The pair is photographed in 4" heel.

name: Olivia Sandals
description: We fall for the dusky look all the time. This golden dusky pair is a testament to that feeling. The sandals come in hues of golden for all those flowing gowns in parties and sangeet functions. Tap your feet in these sleek heels and you will catch some eyeballs. The rusty golden sandal is a perfect crossover between an ethnic Indian shoe and the Western party wear. The hand embroidery and the colour tones are kept classy to go for both themes. The antique golden zardozi and sequins on a lighter golden base are a deadly match on this occasion shoes. They give a slightly dull shine to begin with but boy you throw some light at them and they sparkle like a firefly in the dark. The pair is photographed in 4" heel.

name: Emily Wedges
description: A classic silver wedge never goes out of style. Some shine, some glitz and tons of style, just the way you like it. Silver is the new golden for brides too these days! This wedge heel combines pearl and zardozi hand embroidery in silver tones to make a perfect occasion wear shoe. There is no looking the other way when a bride dons this on her sangeet - compliments galore. A touch of golden beads in the flowers break the tone on tone work and add enough highlight to add to the look of the wedges. We bet you can match it with more than half your occasion wear wardrobe. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.

name: Cinderella Sandals
description: A dream wedding shoes like no other. Charm your groom in a sandals so neatly crafted that it's a hard miss. The baby pink tones and the bow at the back are just MUAH! The wedding sandals come with a gradation in hand embroidery that is meticulously placed. With combination of zari, glass beads and sequins, it is a wonder in its own. The shine yet subtlety of the pair is jaw dropping. It is one pair we hold out when a bride or bridesmaid asks for a statement footwear for a wedding. Can be done equally beautifully in other colour tones with plays of golden embroidery. The pair is photographed in 3" heel.
